rows.source: From your first note to fingerstyle, blues and lead

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 1 “Hello, guitar” · title

rows.source: Hold it, tune it, play your first notes.
rows.translation: Hold den, stem den, og spill dine første toner.

rows.source: Meet your guitar
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 1 · lesson gtr-1-1 “Meet your guitar” · title

rows.source: Six strings, one job
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 1 · lesson gtr-1-1 “Meet your guitar” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: The thickest string is the lowest. It sits nearest your face when you play. We call it string 6.
rows.translation: Den tykkeste strengen har den dypeste tonen. Den er nærmest ansiktet ditt når du spiller. Vi kaller den streng 6.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 1 · lesson gtr-1-1 “Meet your guitar” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Turn to tune
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 1 · lesson gtr-1-1 “Meet your guitar” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: Each string has a tuning peg on the head. Turning it changes the pitch. Timbre listens and tells you which way.
rows.translation: Hver streng har en stemmeskrue på hodet. Når du vrir den, endres tonehøyden. Timbre lytter og viser hvilken vei du skal vri.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 1 · lesson gtr-1-1 “Meet your guitar” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: E minor uses two fingers on fret 2, strings 5 and 4. Every string rings.
rows.translation: E-moll bruker to fingre på bånd 2, streng 5 og 4. Alle strengene klinger.

rows.source: Brush across all six strings from thick to thin, one smooth motion. Keep your wrist loose.

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-2 “Reading tab” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Tab draws six lines, one per string, with string 1 on top. A number on a line is the fret to press. A 0 means play that string open.
rows.translation: Tabulatur har seks linjer, én per streng, med streng 1 øverst. Et tall på en linje er båndet du trykker ned. 0 betyr at du spiller strengen åpen.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-2 “Reading tab” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-3 “Long and short notes” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A half note rings for two beats. Pick once, count one, two, and let it sustain until the next note.
rows.translation: En halvnote klinger i to slag. Slå an én gang, tell en, to, og la tonen klinge til neste tone.

rows.source: Half of a four-beat bar is two beats. A quarter note lasts one beat.
rows.translation: Halvparten av en takt med fire slag er to slag. En firedelsnote varer ett slag.

rows.source: Going from string 2 to string 1 is a tiny move. Keep your picking hand close to the strings so the next note is ready.
rows.translation: Fra streng 2 til streng 1 er det bare en liten bevegelse. Hold anslagshånden nær strengene, klar for neste tone.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-3 “Long and short notes” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Fret 3 on string 2, then open string 1. Lift your finger as you pick.
rows.translation: Bånd 3 på streng 2, så åpen streng 1. Løft fingeren når du slår an.

rows.source: A tune by Beethoven
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · song gtr-2-4 “Ode to Joy” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: This melody comes from Beethoven's Ninth Symphony. It uses C, D, E, F and G, and it moves mostly one step at a time.
rows.translation: Denne melodien kommer fra Beethovens niende symfoni. Den bruker C, D, E, F og G og går stort sett ett trinn om gangen.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · song gtr-2-4 “Ode to Joy” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The first line, slowly: E E F G G F E D.
rows.translation: Første linje, langsomt: E E F G G F E D.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · song gtr-2-4 “Ode to Joy” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Then: C C D E E D D.
rows.translation: Så: C C D E E D D.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · song gtr-2-4 “Ode to Joy” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Long, short, long
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · song gtr-2-4 “Ode to Joy” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Each line ends with a lilt: a longer note, a quick one, then a held one. Count one-and-two, and slip the quick note in on the and.
rows.translation: Hver linje ender med en vuggende rytme: en lengre tone, en rask og en som holdes. Tell en-og-to, og legg den raske tonen på og.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · song gtr-2-4 “Ode to Joy” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: This nursery tune walks on C, D and E, then jumps up to G. The jump is open string 1 to fret 3.
rows.translation: Denne barnesangen går på C, D og E og hopper så opp til G. Spranget går fra åpen streng 1 til bånd 3.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · song gtr-2-5 “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: E D C D E E E: open string 1, down to string 2 and back.
rows.translation: E D C D E E E: åpen streng 1, ned til streng 2 og tilbake.

rows.source: A ballad on two strings

rows.source: Letters in a Shoebox is a Timbre Original, a slow ballad in C. Its chorus lives on strings 1 and 2, and its hook opens with the long, short lilt you played in Ode to Joy. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Letters in a Shoebox er en Timbre-original, en rolig ballade i C. Refrenget ligger på streng 1 og 2, og motivet starter med den lange, korte rytmen du spilte i Ode to Joy. Hele sangen finnes i Sanger, under Originaler.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-spotlight “Song spotlight: Letters in a Shoebox” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The hook: C and D on string 2, then E, F and G on string 1, and back to D.
rows.translation: Motivet: C og D på streng 2, så E, F og G på streng 1, og tilbake til D.

rows.source: E minor, E, A minor and A, played cleanly, and your first chord changes.
rows.translation: E-moll, E, A-moll og A, spilt rent, og dine første akkordskift.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 “First chords” · unit summary

rows.source: Clean chords
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-1 “Clean chords” · title

rows.source: Tips, not pads
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-1 “Clean chords” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Press with your fingertips, arched like a bridge, so no finger leans on the string below it. Short nails make this much easier.
rows.translation: Trykk med fingertuppene, bøyd som en bro, så ingen finger berører strengen under. Korte negler gjør dette mye lettere.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-1 “Clean chords” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Check each string
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-1 “Clean chords” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: Pick the strings one at a time, thick to thin. A dull thud means a finger is touching that string. Adjust and pick it again.
rows.translation: Spill strengene én om gangen, fra tykk til tynn. En dump lyd betyr at en finger berører strengen. Juster og spill den igjen.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-1 “Clean chords” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: E minor, string by string
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-1 “Clean chords” · step 4 (along) · title

rows.source: One string sounds dull. What's the likely cause?
rows.translation: Én streng låter dempet. Hva er trolig årsaken?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-1 “Clean chords” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: A finger is touching it
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-1 “Clean chords” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: You strummed too slowly
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-1 “Clean chords” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The pick is too thin
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-1 “Clean chords” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A fingertip leaning on a neighboring string stops it ringing. Arch your fingers more.
rows.translation: En fingertupp mot nabostrengen hindrer den i å klinge. Bøy fingrene mer.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-1 “Clean chords” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: E major: add one finger
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-2 “E major: add one finger” · title

rows.source: E minor plus one
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-2 “E major: add one finger” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Keep your E minor shape and add your first finger on string 3, fret 1. That one note turns minor into major.
rows.translation: Behold E-mollgrepet og sett første finger på streng 3, bånd 1. Denne ene tonen gjør moll til dur.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-2 “E major: add one finger” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Bright and dark
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-2 “E major: add one finger” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: Major chords tend to sound bright and settled. Minor chords sound darker. E and E minor differ by just one note.
rows.translation: Durakkorder låter gjerne lyst og avklart. Mollakkorder låter mørkere. E og E-moll skiller seg med bare én tone.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-2 “E major: add one finger” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Major or minor?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-2 “E major: add one finger” · step 4 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.source: Major
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-2 “E major: add one finger” · step 4 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.source: Minor
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-2 “E major: add one finger” · step 4 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-2 “E major: add one finger” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.source: A minor
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-3 “A minor” · title

rows.source: Same shape, one string over
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-3 “A minor” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A minor is the E shape moved one string thinner: fingers 2 and 3 on fret 2, finger 1 on string 2, fret 1.
rows.translation: A-moll er E-grepet flyttet én streng mot de tynnere: finger 2 og 3 på bånd 2, finger 1 på streng 2, bånd 1.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-3 “A minor” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Start on the root
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-3 “A minor” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: The root is the note a chord is named after. In A minor it's open string 5, so start your strum there and skip string 6.
rows.translation: Grunntonen er tonen akkorden er oppkalt etter. I A-moll er det åpen streng 5, så start anslaget der og hopp over streng 6.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-3 “A minor” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which string do you skip in A minor?
rows.translation: Hvilken streng hopper du over i A-moll?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-3 “A minor” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: String 1
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-3 “A minor” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: String 6
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-3 “A minor” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: String 5
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-3 “A minor” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A minor's root is open string 5. Start the strum there.
rows.translation: Grunntonen i A-moll er åpen streng 5. Start anslaget der.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-3 “A minor” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Which chord is minor?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-3 “A minor” · step 5 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.source: A minor, string by string
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-3 “A minor” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.source: A major
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-4 “A major” · title

rows.source: Three fingers in a row
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-4 “A major” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A packs fingers 1, 2 and 3 side by side on fret 2, on strings 4, 3 and 2. Strum from string 5.
rows.translation: I A står finger 1, 2 og 3 tett ved siden av hverandre på bånd 2, på streng 4, 3 og 2. Slå an fra streng 5.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-4 “A major” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Crowded? Angle them
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-4 “A major” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: If your fingers feel cramped, slant them so each sits just behind the fret at a slight angle. Keep string 1 clear so it rings.
rows.translation: Hvis det er trangt for fingrene, sett dem litt på skrå rett bak båndet. Hold streng 1 fri så den klinger.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-4 “A major” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which fret holds all three fingers in A?
rows.translation: Hvilket bånd står alle tre fingrene på i A?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-4 “A major” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: From E minor to A minor
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-5 “From E minor to A minor” · title

rows.source: Move the shape, not the fingers
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-5 “From E minor to A minor” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: From E minor to A minor, fingers 2 and 3 hop together to strings 4 and 3. Then finger 1 lands on string 2. Your hand barely moves.
rows.translation: Fra E-moll til A-moll hopper finger 2 og 3 sammen til streng 4 og 3. Så lander finger 1 på streng 2. Hånden beveger seg knapt.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-5 “From E minor to A minor” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Change early, land on one
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-5 “From E minor to A minor” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Strum once, then use the rest of the bar to change. Aim to land the new chord right on beat one. Speed comes later, by itself.
rows.translation: Slå an én gang, og bruk resten av takten til å bytte. Sikt mot å lande den nye akkorden på første slag. Farten kommer senere, av seg selv.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-5 “From E minor to A minor” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: How should your fingers travel between chords?
rows.translation: Hvordan bør fingrene bevege seg mellom akkorder?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-5 “From E minor to A minor” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: One at a time
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-5 “From E minor to A minor” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: As high as possible
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-5 “From E minor to A minor” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Together, as one shape
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-5 “From E minor to A minor” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Moving the fingers as a unit is faster and lands cleaner. Keep them low, just above the strings.
rows.translation: Å flytte fingrene samlet er raskere og gir renere grep. Hold dem lavt, rett over strengene.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-5 “From E minor to A minor” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: From A to E
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-6 “From A to E” · title

rows.source: See the shape first
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-6 “From A to E” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Every finger moves from A to E. Picture the E shape before you lift, then move all three together. Aim finger 2 at string 5.
rows.translation: Alle fingrene flytter seg fra A til E. Se for deg E-grepet før du løfter, og flytt så alle tre sammen. Sikt finger 2 mot streng 5.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-6 “From A to E” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Song spotlight: Dust on the Dashboard
rows.translation: Sang i fokus: Dust on the Dashboard
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-spotlight “Song spotlight: Dust on the Dashboard” · title

rows.source: Country on E and A
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-spotlight “Song spotlight: Dust on the Dashboard” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Dust on the Dashboard is a Timbre Original: country in A. Every verse ends on two bars of E and two of A, the change you just learned. See the shape, move early and land on beat one. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Dust on the Dashboard er en Timbre-original: country i A. Hvert vers slutter med to takter E og to A, skiftet du nettopp lærte. Se for deg grepet, flytt tidlig og land på første slag. Hele sangen finnes i Sanger, under Originaler.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-spotlight “Song spotlight: Dust on the Dashboard” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Does this end at home?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-spotlight “Song spotlight: Dust on the Dashboard” · step 2 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.source: Over E: open B, open E, D at fret 3 on string 2, C sharp at fret 2, then G sharp at fret 1 on string 3.
rows.translation: Over E: åpen B, åpen E, D på bånd 3 på streng 2, C kryss på bånd 2, så G kryss på bånd 1 på streng 3.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-spotlight “Song spotlight: Dust on the Dashboard” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Four chords, clean changes
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · challenge gtr-3-7 “Chord-change challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: No new ideas: E minor, E, A minor and A. Land each shape cleanly, then keep the changes steady.
rows.translation: Ikke noe nytt: E-moll, E, A-moll og A. La hvert grep klinge rent, og hold så skiftene jevne.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · challenge gtr-3-7 “Chord-change challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which finger turns E minor into E?
rows.translation: Hvilken finger gjør E-moll til E?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · challenge gtr-3-7 “Chord-change challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · challenge gtr-3-7 “Chord-change challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Finger 1 on string 3
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · challenge gtr-3-7 “Chord-change challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Finger 1 on string 3, fret 1 is the one note that makes E major.
rows.translation: Finger 1 på streng 3, bånd 1 gir den ene tonen som gjør akkorden til E-dur.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · challenge gtr-3-7 “Chord-change challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Strumming
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 “Strumming” · title

rows.source: Downstrokes, down-up eighths, accents and a strumming hand that never stops.
rows.translation: Nedslag, ned-opp-åttedeler, betoning og en anslagshånd som aldri stopper.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 “Strumming” · unit summary

rows.source: One strum per beat
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-1 “One strum per beat” · title

rows.source: Quarter notes
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-1 “One strum per beat” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A quarter note lasts one beat. Strum down on every beat and count out loud: one, two, three, four.
rows.translation: En firedelsnote varer ett slag. Slå ned på hvert slag og tell høyt: en, to, tre, fire.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-1 “One strum per beat” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Strum from the wrist
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-1 “One strum per beat” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Let the motion come from a loose wrist and forearm, like shaking water off your hand. A stiff arm sounds harsh.
rows.translation: La bevegelsen komme fra et løst håndledd og underarm, som når du rister vann av hånden. En stiv arm gir en hard klang.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-1 “One strum per beat” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: How many quarter-note strums fill a bar of four?
rows.translation: Hvor mange firedelsanslag fyller en takt på fire?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-1 “One strum per beat” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Two
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-1 “One strum per beat” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Four
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-1 “One strum per beat” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Eight
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-1 “One strum per beat” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Down and up
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-2 “Down and up” · title

rows.source: Eighth notes: down-up
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-2 “Down and up” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Split each beat in two. Strum down on the number and up on the and: one and two and. That's eight strums per bar.
rows.translation: Del hvert slag i to. Slå ned på tallet og opp på og: en og to og. Det blir åtte anslag per takt.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-2 “Down and up” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Where does the up strum fall?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-2 “Down and up” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: On the and
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-2 “Down and up” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: On the number
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-2 “Down and up” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Only on beat four
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-2 “Down and up” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Down on the number, up on the and. Your hand goes down and up once per beat.
rows.translation: Ned på tallet, opp på og. Hånden går ned og opp én gang per slag.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-2 “Down and up” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Lighter going up
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-2 “Down and up” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Up strums are naturally softer. Brush just the thinner three or four strings on the way up. That gives the groove its lift.
rows.translation: Oppslag er naturlig svakere. Stryk bare over de tre eller fire tynneste strengene på vei opp. Det gir rytmen løft.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-2 “Down and up” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Accent beat one
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-3 “Accent beat one” · title

rows.source: Lean on one
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-3 “Accent beat one” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: An accent is a note played a little louder. Strum beat one harder than the rest. It tells everyone where the bar begins.
rows.translation: En betoning er en tone som spilles litt sterkere. Slå an første slag kraftigere enn resten. Det viser alle hvor takten starter.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-3 “Accent beat one” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which beat gets the accent?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-3 “Accent beat one” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Beat three
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-3 “Accent beat one” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Every and
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-3 “Accent beat one” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Beat one
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-3 “Accent beat one” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Beat one starts the bar. A slightly louder first strum keeps you, and anyone listening, in time.
rows.translation: Første slag starter takten. Et litt sterkere førsteanslag holder både deg og dem som lytter, i takt.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-3 “Accent beat one” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Count the bars
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-3 “Accent beat one” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Say the bar number on beat one: one, two, three, four; two, two, three, four. You always know where you are.
rows.translation: Si taktnummeret på første slag: en, to, tre, fire; to, to, tre, fire. Da vet du alltid hvor du er.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-3 “Accent beat one” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Keep the hand moving
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-4 “Keep the hand moving” · title

rows.source: A pendulum hand
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-4 “Keep the hand moving” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Your strumming hand swings down and up all the time, like a pendulum. To skip a strum, keep swinging and simply miss the strings.
rows.translation: Anslagshånden svinger ned og opp hele tiden, som en pendel. For å hoppe over et anslag fortsetter du bevegelsen, men lar være å treffe strengene.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-4 “Keep the hand moving” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: To skip a strum, your hand…
rows.translation: For å hoppe over et anslag skal hånden…
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-4 “Keep the hand moving” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Keeps moving and misses the strings
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-4 “Keep the hand moving” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Stops and waits
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-4 “Keep the hand moving” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Strums twice as hard
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-4 “Keep the hand moving” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A hand that never stops keeps steady time. The skipped strum is a swing that doesn't touch the strings.
rows.translation: En hånd som aldri stopper, holder jevn takt. Det utelatte anslaget er en bevegelse som ikke berører strengene.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-4 “Keep the hand moving” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: The folk strum
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-5 “The folk strum” · title

rows.source: Down, down-up, up-down-up
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-5 “The folk strum” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: This pattern drives countless songs. On beat three your hand swings down without touching the strings, then catches the up strum.
rows.translation: Dette mønsteret driver utallige sanger. På tredje slag svinger hånden ned uten å berøre strengene, og treffer dem så på oppslaget.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-5 “The folk strum” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In this pattern, which beat has no strum on the number?
rows.translation: I dette mønsteret, hvilket slag har ikke anslag på tallet?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-5 “The folk strum” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: One
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-5 “The folk strum” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Three
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-5 “The folk strum” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: On three the hand swings down past the strings, then strums up on the and.
rows.translation: På tre svinger hånden ned forbi strengene og slår så opp på og.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-5 “The folk strum” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Song spotlight: Low Tide Radio
rows.translation: Sang i fokus: Low Tide Radio
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-spotlight “Song spotlight: Low Tide Radio” · title

rows.source: Reggae on the ands
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-spotlight “Song spotlight: Low Tide Radio” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Low Tide Radio is a Timbre Original: laid-back reggae on E minor and A. The guitar plays only the ands. Keep your hand swinging down and up, miss the strings on each number and catch every and. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Low Tide Radio er en Timbre-original: avslappet reggae på E-moll og A. Gitaren spiller bare og-slagene. La hånden svinge ned og opp, forbi strengene på hvert tall og mot dem på hvert og. Hele sangen finnes i Sanger, under Originaler.

rows.source: F without the barre
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · lesson gtr-7-1 “The mini F” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: This small F uses four strings. Finger 1 lies flat across strings 1 and 2 at fret 1, finger 2 goes on string 3, fret 2, and finger 3 on string 4, fret 3.
rows.translation: Denne lille F-en bruker fire strenger. Finger 1 ligger flatt over streng 1 og 2 på bånd 1, finger 2 går på streng 3, bånd 2, og finger 3 på streng 4, bånd 3.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · lesson gtr-7-1 “The mini F” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Roll, don't crush
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · lesson gtr-7-1 “The mini F” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: Tilt finger 1 slightly onto its thumb side. The bonier edge presses two strings more easily. Check that string 2 rings.
rows.translation: Vipp finger 1 litt over mot tommelsiden. Den hardere kanten trykker lettere ned to strenger. Sjekk at streng 2 klinger.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · lesson gtr-7-1 “The mini F” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: This progression climbs step by step from A minor and lands on your new F. Strum twice per chord and change early.
rows.translation: Denne akkordrekken stiger trinnvis fra A-moll og lander på din nye F. Slå an to ganger per akkord og bytt tidlig.

rows.source: This English tune is over 400 years old. Its chords are all ones you know: A minor, C, G, E minor, F and E. It's in three: strum once per bar, then on every beat.
rows.translation: Denne engelske melodien er over 400 år gammel. Du kan alle akkordene: A-moll, C, G, E-moll, F og E. Den går i tretakt: slå an én gang per takt, så på hvert slag.

rows.source: A sharp raises a note by one fret. Greensleeves uses G sharp on string 3, fret 1, and F sharp on string 4, fret 4. Reach that one with your little finger.

rows.source: D7 and the Clementine chords

rows.source: D7 leans toward G
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · lesson gtr-7-4 “D7 and the Clementine chords” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A seventh chord adds a note that pulls toward home. D7 wants to move to G. Fingers: 2 on string 3, fret 2; 1 on string 2, fret 1; 3 on string 1, fret 2.
rows.translation: En septimakkord legger til en tone som trekker hjemover. D7 vil gå til G. Fingre: 2 på streng 3, bånd 2; 1 på streng 2, bånd 1; 3 på streng 1, bånd 2.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · lesson gtr-7-4 “D7 and the Clementine chords” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: This American ballad from the 1880s needs only G and D7. It's in three, like Amazing Grace. Strum once per bar, then on every beat.
rows.translation: Denne amerikanske balladen fra 1880-årene trenger bare G og D7. Den går i tretakt, som Amazing Grace. Slå an én gang per takt, så på hvert slag.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · lesson gtr-7-4 “D7 and the Clementine chords” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Three strings and a stretch
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · song gtr-7-5 “Clementine” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Clementine's melody sits on strings 4, 3 and 2. Its last line uses F sharp again: string 4, fret 4, little finger.
rows.translation: Melodien til Clementine ligger på streng 4, 3 og 2. Siste linje bruker F kryss igjen: streng 4, bånd 4, lillefinger.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · song gtr-7-5 “Clementine” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The opening: G G G, down to open D, up to open B.

rows.source: D7's extra note leans toward G. When G arrives, the tension lets go.
rows.translation: Ekstratonen i D7 trekker mot G. Når G kommer, slipper spenningen.

rows.source: Song spotlight: Ghost Light
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · lesson gtr-7-spotlight “Song spotlight: Ghost Light” · title

rows.source: A ballad in A minor
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · lesson gtr-7-spotlight “Song spotlight: Ghost Light” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Ghost Light is a Timbre Original: a slow, dark ballad. Its verse walks A minor, F, C and E, so your mini F gets a song, and the G sharp in E pulls the tune back home. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Ghost Light er en Timbre-original: en rolig, mørk ballade. Verset går gjennom A-moll, F, C og E, så mini-F får en sang, og G kryss i E trekker melodien hjem igjen. Hele sangen finnes i Sanger, under Originaler.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · lesson gtr-7-spotlight “Song spotlight: Ghost Light” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Listen to the verse's last chord. Major or minor?
rows.translation: Lytt til siste akkord i verset. Dur eller moll?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · lesson gtr-7-spotlight “Song spotlight: Ghost Light” · step 3 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.source: Big on one
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · lesson gtr-7-spotlight “Song spotlight: Ghost Light” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: The ballad strum: one big strum on beat one and let it ring, another on three, then down-up on four. The space after each strum is part of the song.
rows.translation: Balladeanslaget: ett stort anslag på første slag som får klinge, et nytt på tre, så ned-opp på fire. Rommet etter hvert anslag er en del av sangen.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · lesson gtr-7-spotlight “Song spotlight: Ghost Light” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The verse's last line: open B, C at fret 1, B, G sharp at fret 1 on string 3, B, then open E.
rows.translation: Siste linje i verset: åpen B, C på bånd 1, B, G kryss på bånd 1 på streng 3, B, så åpen E.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · lesson gtr-7-spotlight “Song spotlight: Ghost Light” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Play E, then lift finger 3 off string 4. The open D that rings is the seventh, a note that adds bluesy tension.
rows.translation: Spill E, og løft så finger 3 fra streng 4. Den åpne D-en som klinger, er septimen, en tone som gir bluespreget spenning.

rows.source: Play A, then lift finger 2 off string 3. Open G rings, and A becomes A7.
rows.translation: Spill A, og løft så finger 2 fra streng 3. Åpen G klinger, og A blir A7.

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-2 “G7 and B7” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: G7 keeps the low G but puts F on top: finger 3 on string 6, fret 3; finger 2 on string 5, fret 2; finger 1 on string 1, fret 1.
rows.translation: G7 beholder den dype G-en, men har F øverst: finger 3 på streng 6, bånd 3; finger 2 på streng 5, bånd 2; finger 1 på streng 1, bånd 1.

rows.translation: Bygg B7 fra streng 5: finger 2 på bånd 2, finger 1 på streng 4, bånd 1, finger 3 på streng 3, bånd 2, lillefinger på streng 1, bånd 2. Streng 2 klinger åpen.

rows.source: B7 pulls toward E. Its tension melts into E minor or E.

rows.source: The shuffle
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-3 “The shuffle” · title

rows.source: Long-short, long-short
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-3 “The shuffle” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A shuffle splits each beat unevenly: a long strum down, a short one up. It's the heartbeat of the blues. Think hum-pty, dum-pty.
rows.translation: En shuffle deler hvert slag ujevnt: et langt nedslag, et kort oppslag. Det er bluesens hjerteslag. Tenk hum-pty, dum-pty.

rows.source: Twelve bars of blues
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-4 “12-bar blues in E” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Many blues songs follow one 12-bar plan. In E: four bars of E7, two of A7, two of E7, then one each of B7, A7, E7 and B7.
rows.translation: Mange bluessanger følger ett 12-takters mønster. I E: fire takter E7, to A7, to E7, så én hver med B7, A7, E7 og B7.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-4 “12-bar blues in E” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The turnaround
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-4 “12-bar blues in E” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: The last four bars move faster: B7, A7, E7, then B7, which turns you around to the top. Change early and keep the shuffle going.
rows.translation: De siste fire taktene skifter raskere: B7, A7, E7, så B7, som leder deg tilbake til starten. Bytt tidlig og hold shufflen i gang.

rows.source: A sus chord swaps the note that makes it major or minor for a neighbor. It sounds open and unresolved until it settles home.
rows.translation: En susakkord bytter tonen som gjør den til dur eller moll, med en nabotone. Den låter åpent og uavklart til den faller til ro hjemme.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-5 “Sus chords” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which chord sounds settled?

rows.source: Lift finger 2 off string 1 to get Dsus2. For Asus4, play A and add your little finger on string 2, fret 3.
rows.translation: Løft finger 2 fra streng 1 for å få Dsus2. For Asus4 spiller du A og legger lillefingeren på streng 2, bånd 3.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-5 “Sus chords” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: A shuffle with a tune
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-spotlight “Song spotlight: Rust Belt Shuffle” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Rust Belt Shuffle is a Timbre Original: a 12-bar blues in E, the plan you just strummed, with a swung tune on top. Keep the long-short feel in both hands. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Rust Belt Shuffle er en Timbre-original: en 12-takters blues i E, mønsteret du nettopp slo an, med en svingende melodi over. Hold lang-kort-følelsen i begge hender. Hele sangen finnes i Sanger, under Originaler.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-spotlight “Song spotlight: Rust Belt Shuffle” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Open G, then G sharp at fret 1 on string 3, then open B: the bluesy slide in bar two.
rows.translation: Åpen G, så G kryss på bånd 1 på streng 3, så åpen B: den bluespregede glidningen i andre takt.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-spotlight “Song spotlight: Rust Belt Shuffle” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Bar two slides from G to G sharp. Which one belongs to E7?
rows.translation: Andre takt glir fra G til G kryss. Hvilken hører til E7?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-spotlight “Song spotlight: Rust Belt Shuffle” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: G sharp
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-spotlight “Song spotlight: Rust Belt Shuffle” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: E7 is E, G sharp, B and D. G is the blue note: it rubs against the chord, then slides into it.
rows.translation: E7 er E, G kryss, B og D. G er den blå tonen: den gnisser mot akkorden og glir så inn i den.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-spotlight “Song spotlight: Rust Belt Shuffle” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: First four bars
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-spotlight “Song spotlight: Rust Belt Shuffle” · step 5 (along) · title

rows.source: Bar nine, over B7: F sharp at fret 2 on string 1, open E, D sharp at fret 4 on string 2 with your little finger, then B.
rows.translation: Niende takt, over B7: F kryss på bånd 2 på streng 1, åpen E, D kryss på bånd 4 på streng 2 med lillefingeren, så B.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-spotlight “Song spotlight: Rust Belt Shuffle” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Sevenths, sus and shuffle
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · challenge gtr-8-6 “Blues challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: No new ideas: seventh chords, sus chords and the 12-bar shuffle. Keep the long-short swing steady through every change.
rows.translation: Ikke noe nytt: septimakkorder, susakkorder og 12-takters shuffle. Hold lang-kort-svingen jevn gjennom hvert skift.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · challenge gtr-8-6 “Blues challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which chord uses all four fingers?
rows.translation: Hvilken akkord bruker alle fire fingre?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · challenge gtr-8-6 “Blues challenge” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Power chords and riffs
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 9 “Power chords and riffs” · title

rows.source: Power chords, open and movable, palm muting and a riff of your own.
rows.translation: Powerakkorder, åpne og flyttbare, håndflatedemping og ditt eget riff.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 9 “Power chords and riffs” · unit summary

rows.source: E5 and A5
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-1 “E5 and A5” · title

rows.source: Two notes, big sound
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-1 “E5 and A5” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A power chord plays only the root and the fifth, the note five letters up. Neither major nor minor, it stays punchy, even loud. E5 is the bottom of E minor.
rows.translation: En powerakkord spiller bare grunntonen og kvinten, tonen fem bokstavtrinn opp. Verken dur eller moll, den beholder trøkket, også sterkt spilt. E5 er den nederste delen av E-moll.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-1 “E5 and A5” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: A5: one string over
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-1 “E5 and A5” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Move the same two fingers to strings 4 and 3. With open string 5, that's A5. Aim your strum at strings 5, 4 and 3 only.
rows.translation: Flytt de samme to fingrene til streng 4 og 3. Sammen med åpen streng 5 er det A5. Sikt anslaget bare mot streng 5, 4 og 3.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-1 “E5 and A5” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which notes make a power chord?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-1 “E5 and A5” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Root and third
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-1 “E5 and A5” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Three open strings
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-1 “E5 and A5” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Root and fifth
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-1 “E5 and A5” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Palm muting
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-2 “Palm muting” · title

rows.source: Rest the edge of your hand
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-2 “Palm muting” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Lay the outer edge of your picking hand on the strings, right where they meet the bridge. Strum, and the notes turn short and chunky.
rows.translation: Legg ytterkanten av anslagshånden på strengene, akkurat der de møter stolen. Slå an, og tonene blir korte og kompakte.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-2 “Palm muting” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Where does your palm rest for palm muting?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-2 “Palm muting” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Over the sound hole
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-2 “Palm muting” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: On the frets
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-2 “Palm muting” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Near the neck
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-2 “Palm muting” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Right at the bridge
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-2 “Palm muting” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: At the bridge the strings still sound, just shorter. Move forward and they go dead.
rows.translation: Ved stolen låter strengene fortsatt, bare kortere. Flytt fremover, så blir de helt dempet.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-2 “Palm muting” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Mute, then open
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-2 “Palm muting” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Rock often builds with muted eighths, then lands on an open chord. Lift your palm for the big strum and let it ring.
rows.translation: Rock bygger ofte opp med dempede åttedeler og lander så på en åpen akkord. Løft hånden for det store anslaget og la det klinge.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-2 “Palm muting” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Movable power chords
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-3 “Movable power chords” · title

rows.source: One shape, every chord
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-3 “Movable power chords” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Finger 1 on string 6, fret 3, then fingers 3 and 4 two frets higher on strings 5 and 4. That's G5. Slide it and the name follows the fret.
rows.translation: Finger 1 på streng 6, bånd 3, så finger 3 og 4 to bånd høyere på streng 5 og 4. Det er G5. Flytt grepet, så følger navnet båndet.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-3 “Movable power chords” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Your root is on string 6, fret 5. Which power chord is it?
rows.translation: Grunntonen er på streng 6, bånd 5. Hvilken powerakkord er det?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-3 “Movable power chords” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Count up string 6: E open, F at 1, G at 3, A at 5.
rows.translation: Tell opp streng 6: E åpen, F på 1, G på 3, A på 5.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-3 “Movable power chords” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Root on string 5
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-3 “Movable power chords” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: The same shape works from string 5. Finger 1 on string 5, fret 3 gives C5. Let the tip of finger 1 touch string 6 to keep it quiet.
rows.translation: Samme grep virker fra streng 5. Finger 1 på streng 5, bånd 3 gir C5. La tuppen av finger 1 berøre streng 6 for å holde den stille.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-3 “Movable power chords” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Your first riff
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-4 “Your first riff” · title

rows.source: A riff is a hook
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-4 “Your first riff” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A riff is a short, catchy phrase that repeats. This one bounces off open low E. Rest your palm at the bridge to keep it tight.
rows.translation: Et riff er en kort, fengende frase som gjentas. Dette spretter fra åpen, dyp E. La hånden hvile ved stolen for en stram lyd.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-4 “Your first riff” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Open E, string 6 at fret 3, then open A.
rows.translation: Åpen E, streng 6 på bånd 3, så åpen A.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-4 “Your first riff” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Reach for fret 5
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-4 “Your first riff” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: The second bar climbs string 5: fret 2, then fret 5 with your little finger, then back to fret 2. Keep finger 1 parked near fret 2.
rows.translation: Andre takt stiger på streng 5: bånd 2, så bånd 5 med lillefingeren, og tilbake til bånd 2. Hold finger 1 nær bånd 2.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-4 “Your first riff” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: String 5: fret 2, fret 5 with your little finger, fret 2 again.
rows.translation: Streng 5: bånd 2, bånd 5 med lillefingeren, bånd 2 igjen.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-4 “Your first riff” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: What makes a riff a riff?
rows.translation: Hva gjør et riff til et riff?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-4 “Your first riff” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: It repeats
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-4 “Your first riff” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: It's played once
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-4 “Your first riff” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: It uses only chords
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-4 “Your first riff” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Riffs and power chords
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-5 “Riffs and power chords” · title

rows.source: Answer the riff
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-5 “Riffs and power chords” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Songs often answer a riff with power chords. Play the riff, then hit the chords on one, the and of two, and four.
rows.translation: Sanger svarer ofte på et riff med powerakkorder. Spill riffet, og slå så an akkordene på en, og etter to, og fire.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-5 “Riffs and power chords” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Slide G5 up two frets. What do you get?
rows.translation: Flytt G5 to bånd opp. Hva får du?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-5 “Riffs and power chords” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Two frets above G is A. The chord's name moves with its root.
rows.translation: To bånd over G er A. Akkordnavnet flytter seg med grunntonen.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-5 “Riffs and power chords” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Song spotlight: Basement Weather
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-spotlight “Song spotlight: Basement Weather” · title

rows.source: Garage rock in A
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-spotlight “Song spotlight: Basement Weather” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Basement Weather is a Timbre Original: garage rock in A. A riff on the low strings opens it, then power chords punch back on one, the and of two, and four. Keep your palm at the bridge. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Basement Weather er en Timbre-original: garasjerock i A. Et riff på de dype strengene åpner, så svarer powerakkorder med trøkk på en, og etter to, og fire. Hold hånden ved stolen. Hele sangen finnes i Sanger, under Originaler.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-spotlight “Song spotlight: Basement Weather” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Open A, C at fret 3 on string 5, open D, then G at fret 3 on string 6 and open low E.
rows.translation: Åpen A, C på bånd 3 på streng 5, åpen D, så G på bånd 3 på streng 6 og åpen, dyp E.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-spotlight “Song spotlight: Basement Weather” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: D5: slide C5 up
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-spotlight “Song spotlight: Basement Weather” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: You know C5, with finger 1 on string 5, fret 3. Slide the whole shape up two frets and it becomes D5. G5 sits at fret 3 too, one string lower than C5.
rows.translation: Du kan C5, med finger 1 på streng 5, bånd 3. Flytt hele grepet to bånd opp, så blir det D5. G5 ligger også på bånd 3, én streng dypere enn C5.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-spotlight “Song spotlight: Basement Weather” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Riff challenge
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · challenge gtr-9-6 “Riff challenge” · title

rows.source: Power and precision
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · challenge gtr-9-6 “Riff challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: No new ideas: power chords, open and movable, palm muting and your riff. Lock in with the click and keep the mutes tight.
rows.translation: Ikke noe nytt: powerakkorder, åpne og flyttbare, håndflatedemping og riffet ditt. Følg klikket tett og hold dempingen stram.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · challenge gtr-9-6 “Riff challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Your root is on string 5, fret 3. Which power chord is it?
rows.translation: Grunntonen er på streng 5, bånd 3. Hvilken powerakkord er det?

rows.source: String 5 counts up from A: B at 2, C at 3.
rows.translation: Streng 5 telles opp fra A: B på 2, C på 3.

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 10 “Barre chords and the pentatonic” · title

rows.source: The F barre and B minor, the A minor pentatonic scale and your first solo.
rows.translation: F-barré og B-moll, den A-mollpentatone skalaen og din første solo.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 10 “Barre chords and the pentatonic” · unit summary

rows.source: On the way to F
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-1 “On the way to F” · title

rows.source: Three steps to F
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-1 “On the way to F” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Full barre chords take weeks, so build up to them. You know the mini F. Next comes a five-string F, then the full barre.
rows.translation: Fullstendige barréakkorder tar uker, så bygg deg opp til dem. Du kan mini-F. Neste trinn er en F på fem strenger, så full barré.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-1 “On the way to F” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Add string 5
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-1 “On the way to F” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: Move finger 3 to string 5, fret 3, and put your little finger on string 4, fret 3. Five strings ring and the F sounds fuller.
rows.translation: Flytt finger 3 til streng 5, bånd 3, og sett lillefingeren på streng 4, bånd 3. Fem strenger klinger, og F får fyldigere klang.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-1 “On the way to F” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Barre chords feel hard at first. What helps most?
rows.translation: Barréakkorder er vanskelige i starten. Hva hjelper mest?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-1 “On the way to F” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: A few minutes every day
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-1 “On the way to F” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Squeezing as hard as you can
rows.translation: Å klemme så hardt du kan
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-1 “On the way to F” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Skipping them for now
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-1 “On the way to F” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Strength and feel build slowly. Short, daily practice beats one long, painful session.
rows.translation: Styrke og følelse bygges langsomt. Kort, daglig øving er bedre enn én lang, smertefull økt.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-1 “On the way to F” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: The full F barre
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-2 “The full F barre” · title

rows.source: One finger, six strings
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-2 “The full F barre” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Lay finger 1 flat across all six strings at fret 1. Fingers 2, 3 and 4 make an E shape in front of it. F is E moved up one fret.
rows.translation: Legg finger 1 flatt over alle seks strenger på bånd 1. Finger 2, 3 og 4 danner et E-grep foran den. F er E flyttet ett bånd opp.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-2 “The full F barre” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Pull, don't squeeze
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-2 “The full F barre” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: Let your arm's weight pull the barre in, as if gently drawing the neck toward you. Your thumb only steadies. Roll finger 1 onto its side.
rows.translation: La armens vekt trekke barrégrepet inn, som om du forsiktig trakk halsen mot deg. Tommelen støtter bare. Rull finger 1 over på siden.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-2 “The full F barre” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: F, string by string
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-2 “The full F barre” · step 4 (along) · title

rows.source: The F barre is which open shape, moved up a fret?
rows.translation: F-barré er hvilket åpent grep flyttet ett bånd opp?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-2 “The full F barre” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: B minor
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-3 “B minor” · title

rows.source: B minor: barre at fret 2
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-3 “B minor” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Finger 1 barres strings 1 to 5 at fret 2. Fingers 2, 3 and 4 build an A minor shape two frets higher. Skip string 6.
rows.translation: Finger 1 holder barré over streng 1 til 5 på bånd 2. Finger 2, 3 og 4 bygger et A-mollgrep to bånd høyere. Hopp over streng 6.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-3 “B minor” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: An easier B minor
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-3 “B minor” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: Not ready to barre? Play the top four strings only: fret 4 on strings 4 and 3, fret 3 on string 2, fret 2 on string 1.
rows.translation: Ikke klar for barré? Spill bare de fire øverste strengene: bånd 4 på streng 4 og 3, bånd 3 på streng 2, bånd 2 på streng 1.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-3 “B minor” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which chord is E moved up one fret with a barre?
rows.translation: Hvilken akkord er E flyttet ett bånd opp med barré?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-3 “B minor” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: The A minor pentatonic
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-4 “The A minor pentatonic” · title

rows.source: Five notes for soloing
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-4 “The A minor pentatonic” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: The minor pentatonic scale has five notes. In A minor they're A, C, D, E and G. It's the sound of countless blues and rock solos.
rows.translation: Den mollpentatone skalaen har fem toner. I A-moll er de A, C, D, E og G. Det er lyden av utallige blues- og rockesoloer.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-4 “The A minor pentatonic” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Box 1 at fret 5
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-4 “The A minor pentatonic” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: Finger 1 covers fret 5 on every string. Fingers 3 and 4 take frets 7 and 8. Two notes per string, one finger per fret.
rows.translation: Finger 1 dekker bånd 5 på hver streng. Finger 3 og 4 tar bånd 7 og 8. To toner per streng, én finger per bånd.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-4 “The A minor pentatonic” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Fret 5, fret 8 on string 6, then fret 5, fret 7 on string 5.
rows.translation: Bånd 5, bånd 8 på streng 6, så bånd 5, bånd 7 på streng 5.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-4 “The A minor pentatonic” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Strings 6 and 5
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-4 “The A minor pentatonic” · step 4 (along) · title

rows.source: Which notes are in A minor pentatonic?
rows.translation: Hvilke toner er med i A-mollpentatonikk?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-4 “The A minor pentatonic” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Strings 4 and 3
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-4 “The A minor pentatonic” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.source: Strings 2 and 1
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-4 “The A minor pentatonic” · step 7 (along) · title

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-5 “Your first solo” · title

rows.source: Phrase like you speak
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-5 “Your first solo” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A solo is a melody built from short phrases. Play a few notes, leave a gap, then answer. Ending on A, the root, sounds like a full stop.
rows.translation: En solo er en melodi bygd av korte fraser. Spill noen toner, la det bli et mellomrom, og svar så. Å ende på grunntonen A høres ut som et punktum.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-5 “Your first solo” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The question
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-5 “Your first solo” · step 2 (along) · title

rows.source: The answer
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-5 “Your first solo” · step 3 (along) · title

rows.source: Which note sounds most like a full stop in A minor?
rows.translation: Hvilken tone høres mest ut som et punktum i A-moll?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-5 “Your first solo” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: A is the root, the home of A minor. Ending a phrase on it sounds finished.
rows.translation: A er grunntonen, hjemmet i A-moll. En frase som ender der, høres avsluttet ut.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-5 “Your first solo” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Song spotlight: Glass Satellites
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-spotlight “Song spotlight: Glass Satellites” · title

rows.source: A power ballad with a barre

rows.source: Glass Satellites is a Timbre Original: a power ballad on A minor, F, C and G. Your full F barre takes the second chord, and box 1 fits over the whole loop, so it gets a solo. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.

rows.source: Thumb on the bass
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-1 “Thumb on the bass” · title

rows.source: Your thumb keeps the beat
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-1 “Thumb on the bass” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Fingerpicking means plucking with your fingers instead of a pick. Your thumb owns the bass strings, 6, 5 and 4, and plays on the beat like a bass drum.
rows.translation: Fingerspill betyr å knipse med fingrene i stedet for plekter. Tommelen tar bassstrengene, 6, 5 og 4, og spiller på slaget som en basstromme.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-1 “Thumb on the bass” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Thumb only: push down through strings 6, 5 and 4, one at a time.
rows.translation: Bare tommel: skyv ned gjennom streng 6, 5 og 4, én om gangen.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-1 “Thumb on the bass” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: The thumb takes the bass strings. Your fingers take the thinner ones.
rows.translation: Tommelen tar bassstrengene. Fingrene tar de tynnere.

rows.source: Hold A minor. Your thumb plays the root on string 5, then rocks over to string 4, the chord's fifth. Root, fifth, root, fifth: that's an alternating bass.
rows.translation: Hold A-moll. Tommelen spiller grunntonen på streng 5 og veksler så til streng 4, akkordens kvint. Grunntone, kvint, grunntone, kvint: det er vekselbass.

rows.source: Letters for your fingers
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-2 “p, i, m and a” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Fingerstyle borrows Spanish names: p for the thumb, i index, m middle, a ring. Rest i on string 3, m on string 2 and a on string 1, ready to pluck.
rows.translation: Fingerspill låner spanske navn: p for tommel, i pekefinger, m langfinger, a ringfinger. La i hvile på streng 3, m på streng 2 og a på streng 1, klare til å knipse.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-2 “p, i, m and a” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: i, m, a: index on string 3, middle on 2, ring on 1.
rows.translation: i, m, a: pekefinger på streng 3, langfinger på 2, ringfinger på 1.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-2 “p, i, m and a” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: p tommel, i pekefinger, m langfinger, a ringfinger. Lillefingeren hviler vanligvis.

rows.source: Pluck into your palm
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-2 “p, i, m and a” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Each finger plucks up and slightly toward your palm, then relaxes. Keep your hand still above the strings and let the fingers do the moving.
rows.translation: Hver finger knipser opp og litt inn mot håndflaten, og slapper så av. Hold hånden i ro over strengene og la fingrene gjøre bevegelsen.

rows.source: Thumb steady, fingers between
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-3 “Travis picking” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Travis picking, named after Merle Travis, keeps the thumb alternating on every beat while the fingers pluck in between, on the ands.
rows.translation: Travis-plukking, oppkalt etter Merle Travis, lar tommelen veksle på hvert slag mens fingrene knipser imellom, på og-slagene.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-3 “Travis picking” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-3 “Travis picking” · step 2 (along) · title

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-3 “Travis picking” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Rests while the fingers play
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-3 “Travis picking” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Alternates bass notes on every beat
rows.translation: Veksler mellom basstoner på hvert slag
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-3 “Travis picking” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The thumb is the steady pulse: a bass note on every beat, rocking between two strings.
rows.translation: Tommelen er den jevne pulsen: en basstone på hvert slag, vekselvis på to strenger.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-3 “Travis picking” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Add the fingers
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-3 “Travis picking” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Keep the thumb going. Between thumb notes, m plucks string 2 and i plucks string 3: thumb, m, thumb, i. Go slowly until it runs by itself.
rows.translation: Hold tommelen i gang. Mellom tommeltonene knipser m streng 2 og i streng 3: tommel, m, tommel, i. Spill langsomt til det går av seg selv.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-3 “Travis picking” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-3 “Travis picking” · step 5 (along) · title

rows.source: Between thumb notes, which finger plucks string 2?
rows.translation: Hvilken finger knipser streng 2 mellom tommeltonene?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-3 “Travis picking” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: In this pattern m takes string 2 and i takes string 3. The a finger rests for now.
rows.translation: I dette mønsteret tar m streng 2 og i streng 3. Fingeren a hviler foreløpig.

rows.source: When the chord changes, the thumb lands on the new root right on beat one. The fingers keep plucking strings 2 and 3 as before.
rows.translation: Når akkorden skifter, lander tommelen på den nye grunntonen på første slag. Fingrene fortsetter å knipse streng 2 og 3 som før.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-4 “Travis through the changes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The bass tells the ear which chord you're on. Landing the root on beat one makes the change clear.
rows.translation: Bassen forteller øret hvilken akkord du spiller. Grunntonen på første slag gjør skiftet tydelig.

rows.source: Hold each chord for the whole bar so every note rings into the next. Lift a finger only when the next shape needs it.
rows.translation: Hold hver akkord hele takten så hver tone klinger inn i den neste. Løft en finger bare når neste grep trenger det.

rows.source: Rolling arpeggios
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-5 “A fingerpicked ballad” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: An arpeggio plays a chord one note at a time. This one rolls p, i, m, a, then back down m, i. Six notes fill a bar of three, two to a beat.
rows.translation: Et arpeggio spiller en akkord én tone om gangen. Her ruller p, i, m, a, og så ned igjen m, i. Seks toner fyller en tretakt, to per slag.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-5 “A fingerpicked ballad” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-5 “A fingerpicked ballad” · step 2 (along) · title

rows.source: After a plucks string 1, which finger comes next?
rows.translation: Hvilken finger kommer etter at a knipser streng 1?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-5 “A fingerpicked ballad” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: The roll turns around at the top: p, i, m, a, then m and i on the way back.
rows.translation: Mønsteret snur på toppen: p, i, m, a, så m og i på vei tilbake.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-5 “A fingerpicked ballad” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: One bar each: A minor, F, C, G, then A minor, F, E, A minor. Your thumb finds each new root: strings 5, 4, 5 and 6.
rows.translation: Én takt hver: A-moll, F, C, G, så A-moll, F, E, A-moll. Tommelen finner hver nye grunntone: streng 5, 4, 5 og 6.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-5 “A fingerpicked ballad” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: A ballad, fingerpicked
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-spotlight “Song spotlight: Porchlight” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Porchlight is a Timbre Original: a slow ballad in D. Fingerpick it: your thumb on each chord's root, then i, m and a up strings 3, 2 and 1. Let every note ring into the next. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Porchlight er en Timbre-original: en rolig ballade i D. Bruk fingerspill: tommelen på hver akkords grunntone, så i, m og a opp streng 3, 2 og 1. La hver tone klinge inn i den neste. Hele sangen finnes i Sanger, under Originaler.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-spotlight “Song spotlight: Porchlight” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In D, which string does your thumb play?
rows.translation: Hvilken streng spiller tommelen i D?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-spotlight “Song spotlight: Porchlight” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: D's root is open string 4. Strings 5 and 6 stay quiet in this chord.
rows.translation: Grunntonen i D er åpen streng 4. Streng 5 og 6 er stille i denne akkorden.

rows.source: The 12-bar in A, the quick change, a boogie bass line, the turnaround and your first blues licks.
rows.translation: 12-takters blues i A, tidlig skift, en boogiebasslinje, vendingen og dine første blueslicks.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 “Blues” · unit summary

rows.source: The blues in A
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-1 “The blues in A” · title

rows.source: One, four, five
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-1 “The blues in A” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Blues chords sit on the first, fourth and fifth notes of the key. In E that's E7, A7 and B7. Move to the key of A and they become A7, D7 and E7.
rows.translation: Bluesakkorder ligger på første, fjerde og femte tone i tonearten. I E er det E7, A7 og B7. Flytt til A, så blir de A7, D7 og E7.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-1 “The blues in A” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In the key of A, which chord does the job B7 did in E?
rows.translation: Hvilken akkord i A gjør jobben B7 gjorde i E?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-1 “The blues in A” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: B7 is five letters up from E. Five letters up from A is E, so E7 takes its place.
rows.translation: B7 er fem bokstavtrinn opp fra E. Fem bokstavtrinn opp fra A er E, så E7 tar plassen.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-1 “The blues in A” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Twelve bars in A
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-1 “The blues in A” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Four bars of A7, two of D7, two of A7, then one each of E7, D7, A7 and E7. The last E7 turns you back to the top.
rows.translation: Fire takter A7, to D7, to A7, så én hver med E7, D7, A7 og E7. Siste E7 leder deg tilbake til starten.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-1 “The blues in A” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The quick change
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-2 “The quick change” · title

rows.source: Visit the four chord early
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-2 “The quick change” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: In a quick change, bar 2 jumps to the four chord and straight back. In A: A7, D7, A7, A7. It adds motion right from the start.
rows.translation: Med tidlig skift hopper takt 2 til fjerdegradsakkorden og rett tilbake. I A: A7, D7, A7, A7. Det gir bevegelse helt fra starten.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-2 “The quick change” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In a quick change in A, which chord is bar 2?
rows.translation: Hvilken akkord er takt 2 ved tidlig skift i A?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-2 “The quick change” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: The four chord in A is D7. The quick change visits it in bar 2, then returns to A7.
rows.translation: Fjerdegradsakkorden i A er D7. Det tidlige skiftet besøker den i takt 2 og går så tilbake til A7.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-2 “The quick change” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Now in E
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-2 “The quick change” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: The quick change works in any key. In E: E7, A7, E7, E7. Watch for B7 near the end, your four-finger chord.
rows.translation: Det tidlige skiftet virker i alle tonearter. I E: E7, A7, E7, E7. Se etter B7 mot slutten, akkorden med fire fingre.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-2 “The quick change” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: A boogie bass line
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-3 “A boogie bass line” · title

rows.source: Walk the chord
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-3 “A boogie bass line” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A boogie line walks up the chord and back, each note twice, long-short like the shuffle. Over A7 it climbs A, C sharp, E, F sharp, G, then walks back down.
rows.translation: En boogielinje går opp gjennom akkorden og tilbake, hver tone to ganger, lang-kort som shuffle. Over A7 stiger den A, C kryss, E, F kryss, G, og går så ned igjen.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-3 “A boogie bass line” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Open A, fret 4 on string 5, frets 2 and 4 on string 4, then open G.
rows.translation: Åpen A, bånd 4 på streng 5, bånd 2 og 4 på streng 4, så åpen G.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-3 “A boogie bass line” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Boogie in A
