rows.source: Next up: the E shape
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-1 “One chord, five shapes” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Climb from open G and the next shape is the E shape: your G barre at fret 3. Its root on string 6 is the same G as in the open chord.
rows.translation: Gå opp fra åpen G, så er neste form E-grepet: G-barréen på bånd 3. Grunntonen på streng 6 er den samme G-en som i den åpne akkorden.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-1 “One chord, five shapes” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Same chord or different?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-1 “One chord, five shapes” · step 6 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.source: The D shape at fret 5
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-2 “The D shape” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Open D moved up five frets is G. Finger 1 holds string 4 at fret 5, where the nut used to be. Fingers 2, 4 and 3 rebuild the D triangle above it.
rows.translation: Åpen D flyttet fem bånd opp er G. Finger 1 holder streng 4 på bånd 5, der oversadelen var. Finger 2, 4 og 3 bygger D-trekanten over den.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-2 “The D shape” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The D shape, string by string
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-2 “The D shape” · step 3 (along) · title

rows.source: Where is the D shape's root?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-2 “The D shape” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: String 1, under finger 3
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-2 “The D shape” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: String 3, under finger 2
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-2 “The D shape” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: String 4, under finger 1
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-2 “The D shape” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Open D's root is open string 4. Moved up, finger 1 holds it: G at fret 5. String 2, fret 8 is a G too.
rows.translation: Grunntonen i åpen D er åpen streng 4. Flyttet opp holdes den av finger 1: G på bånd 5. Streng 2, bånd 8 er også en G.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-2 “The D shape” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: A shared note
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-2 “The D shape” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: The E shape at fret 3 and the D shape at fret 5 share one note: G on string 4, fret 5. Keep your eyes on it as you move between them.
rows.translation: E-grepet på bånd 3 og D-grepet på bånd 5 deler én tone: G på streng 4, bånd 5. Hold øynene på den når du flytter mellom dem.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-2 “The D shape” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The C shape at fret 7
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-3 “The C shape” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Open C moved up seven frets is G. Finger 1 lies across strings 3, 2 and 1 at fret 7, finger 2 takes string 2 at fret 8, and fingers 3 and 4 stretch to strings 4 and 5.
rows.translation: Åpen C flyttet sju bånd opp er G. Finger 1 ligger over streng 3, 2 og 1 på bånd 7, finger 2 tar streng 2 på bånd 8, og finger 3 og 4 strekkes til streng 4 og 5.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-3 “The C shape” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The C shape, string by string
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-3 “The C shape” · step 3 (along) · title

rows.source: Like open C, the C shape's root is on…
rows.translation: Som i åpen C er grunntonen i C-grepet på…
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-3 “The C shape” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Open C's root is string 5, fret 3. Here your little finger holds it: G at fret 10.
rows.translation: Grunntonen i åpen C er streng 5, bånd 3. Her holder lillefingeren den: G på bånd 10.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-3 “The C shape” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Any chord, same shape
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-3 “The C shape” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Slide the C shape down to fret 2 and it's D, with its root on string 5, fret 5. The name always follows the root.
rows.translation: Flytt C-grepet ned til bånd 2, så er det D, med grunntone på streng 5, bånd 5. Navnet følger alltid grunntonen.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-3 “The C shape” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The A shape, and around again
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-4 “The A shape, and around again” · title

rows.source: The A shape at fret 10
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-4 “The A shape, and around again” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Barre strings 5 to 1 at fret 10 and lay finger 3 across strings 4, 3 and 2 at fret 12. It's your A-shape barre, and it's G again.
rows.translation: Hold barré over streng 5 til 1 på bånd 10 og legg finger 3 over streng 4, 3 og 2 på bånd 12. Det er barréen med A-grep, og det er G igjen.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-4 “The A shape, and around again” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Fret 12 starts the cycle again
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-4 “The A shape, and around again” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: Past the A shape, the G shape comes back at fret 12: open G, one octave higher. From there the five shapes repeat in the same order.
rows.translation: Etter A-grepet kommer G-grepet tilbake på bånd 12: åpen G, én oktav høyere. Derfra gjentas de fem grepene i samme rekkefølge.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-4 “The A shape, and around again” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Going up the neck, which shape comes after A?
rows.translation: Hvilket grep kommer etter A oppover halsen?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-4 “The A shape, and around again” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: The order loops: C, A, G, E, D, then C again. After A comes G.
rows.translation: Rekkefølgen går rundt: C, A, G, E, D, så C igjen. Etter A kommer G.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-4 “The A shape, and around again” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Which G is higher?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-4 “The A shape, and around again” · step 5 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.source: Chords near your hand
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-5 “Chords near your hand” · title

rows.source: Stay in one spot
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-5 “Chords near your hand” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: With CAGED you rarely have to jump. Around fret 5, G is the D shape, C is the G shape and D is the A shape. Three chords, one spot.
rows.translation: Med CAGED trenger du sjelden å hoppe. Rundt bånd 5 er G D-grepet, C er G-grepet, og D er A-grepet. Tre akkorder, ett sted.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-5 “Chords near your hand” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which shape plays C right beside the D-shape G?
rows.translation: Hvilket grep spiller C rett ved G med D-grep?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-5 “Chords near your hand” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: C's G shape uses frets 5 and 8, right where your hand already is.
rows.translation: G-grepet til C bruker bånd 5 og 8, akkurat der hånden allerede er.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-5 “Chords near your hand” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Or stay at fret 3
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-5 “Chords near your hand” · step 7 (explain) · title

rows.source: The same idea works lower: G as the E shape at fret 3, C as the A shape at fret 3, and D as the C shape at fret 2.
rows.translation: Samme idé virker lavere: G som E-grep på bånd 3, C som A-grep på bånd 3 og D som C-grep på bånd 2.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-5 “Chords near your hand” · step 7 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Song spotlight: Lantern Hill
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-spotlight “Song spotlight: Lantern Hill” · title

rows.source: One song, three places
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-spotlight “Song spotlight: Lantern Hill” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Lantern Hill is a Timbre Original: a campfire sing-along on G, C and D. Play its chorus open, then near fret 5, then near fret 3, and the same song moves around the neck. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Lantern Hill er en Timbre-original: allsang ved leirbålet på G, C og D. Spill refrenget åpent, så nær bånd 5, så nær bånd 3, og samme sang flytter seg rundt på halsen. Hele sangen finnes i Sanger, under Originaler.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-spotlight “Song spotlight: Lantern Hill” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Near fret 5, which shape plays C?
rows.translation: Hvilket grep spiller C nær bånd 5?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-spotlight “Song spotlight: Lantern Hill” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: C's G shape uses frets 5 and 8, right beside the D-shape G and the A-shape D.
rows.translation: G-grepet til C bruker bånd 5 og 8, rett ved G med D-grep og D med A-grep.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-spotlight “Song spotlight: Lantern Hill” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: The chorus, picked at fret 5
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-spotlight “Song spotlight: Lantern Hill” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.source: CAGED challenge
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · challenge gtr-17-6 “CAGED challenge” · title

rows.source: Five shapes, one neck
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · challenge gtr-17-6 “CAGED challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: No new ideas: G in all five shapes, and G, C and D near fret 3 and fret 5. Name each shape as you land it.
rows.translation: Ikke noe nytt: G i alle fem grep, og G, C og D nær bånd 3 og bånd 5. Si navnet på hvert grep når du lander.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · challenge gtr-17-6 “CAGED challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: G with the D shape sits at…
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · challenge gtr-17-6 “CAGED challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Triads up the neck
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 “Triads up the neck” · title

rows.source: Three-note chords on the top strings: major and minor, every inversion, and progressions that barely move.
rows.translation: Tretonersakkorder på de øverste strengene: dur og moll, alle omvendinger og akkordrekker med knapt noen bevegelse.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 “Triads up the neck” · unit summary

rows.source: Triads on the top strings
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-1 “Triads on the top strings” · title

rows.source: Three notes make a chord
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-1 “Triads on the top strings” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A triad is the smallest full chord: a root, a third and a fifth. On strings 3, 2 and 1, triads ring clear and bright, and they work anywhere on the neck.
rows.translation: En treklang er den minste fullstendige akkorden: grunntone, ters og kvint. På streng 3, 2 og 1 klinger treklanger klart og lyst, og de virker overalt på halsen.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-1 “Triads on the top strings” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: C, root at the bottom
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-1 “Triads on the top strings” · step 3 (along) · title

rows.source: Which notes make a C major triad?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-1 “Triads on the top strings” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: C, E and G
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-1 “Triads on the top strings” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: C, D and E
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-1 “Triads on the top strings” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: C, F and A
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-1 “Triads on the top strings” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Root, third, fifth: from C, skip a letter to E, then skip another to G.
rows.translation: Grunntone, ters, kvint: fra C hopper du over én bokstav til E, så enda én til G.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-1 “Triads on the top strings” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Same notes, new order
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-1 “Triads on the top strings” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Move the lowest note to the top and you get an inversion. With E at the bottom, C sits at frets 9, 8 and 8. With G at the bottom, it's the top of your open C.
rows.translation: Flytt nederste tone til toppen, så får du en omvending. Med E nederst ligger C på bånd 9, 8 og 8. Med G nederst er det toppen av åpen C.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-1 “Triads on the top strings” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Inversions of G and D
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-2 “Inversions of G and D” · title

rows.source: Three shapes for every chord
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-2 “Inversions of G and D” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Every major triad on these strings uses one of three shapes, one per inversion. Learn them on G and D and you can find any major chord.
rows.translation: Hver durtreklang på disse strengene bruker ett av tre grep, ett per omvending. Lær dem på G og D, så kan du finne alle durakkorder.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-2 “Inversions of G and D” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: G at frets 4, 3 and 3 has the same shape as…
rows.translation: G på bånd 4, 3 og 3 har samme form som…
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-2 “Inversions of G and D” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: C at frets 5, 5 and 3
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-2 “Inversions of G and D” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: C at frets 9, 8 and 8
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-2 “Inversions of G and D” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: No other chord
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-2 “Inversions of G and D” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Both put the third at the bottom: one fret up on string 3, the other two level. Same shape, five frets apart.
rows.translation: Begge har tersen nederst: ett bånd opp på streng 3, de to andre på samme bånd. Samme grep, fem bånd fra hverandre.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-2 “Inversions of G and D” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: D, twice
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-2 “Inversions of G and D” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: D at frets 7, 7 and 5 has the root-position shape of your C at fret 5. Lower down, frets 2, 3 and 2 are the top of your open D.
rows.translation: D på bånd 7, 7 og 5 har grunnstillingsformen til C på bånd 5. Lenger ned er bånd 2, 3 og 2 toppen av åpen D.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-2 “Inversions of G and D” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Minor triads
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-3 “Minor triads” · title

rows.source: Lower the third
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-3 “Minor triads” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A minor triad is a major triad with its third one fret lower. On these strings, A minor at frets 2, 1 and 0 is the top of your open A minor.
rows.translation: En molltreklang er en durtreklang med tersen ett bånd lavere. På disse strengene er A-moll på bånd 2, 1 og 0 toppen av åpen A-moll.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-3 “Minor triads” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: A minor at fret 5
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-3 “Minor triads” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Barre fret 5 across strings 3, 2 and 1 and you have A minor with C at the bottom. One finger, three notes.
rows.translation: Hold barré på bånd 5 over streng 3, 2 og 1, så har du A-moll med C nederst. Én finger, tre toner.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-3 “Minor triads” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: E minor beside it
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-3 “Minor triads” · step 6 (explain) · title

rows.source: E minor at frets 4, 5 and 3 puts B at the bottom. It sits right beside A minor at fret 5, so the change is tiny.
rows.translation: E-moll på bånd 4, 5 og 3 har B nederst. Den ligger rett ved A-moll på bånd 5, så skiftet er lite.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-3 “Minor triads” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Triads through a progression
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-4 “Triads through a progression” · title

rows.source: Move to the nearest shape
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-4 “Triads through a progression” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Pick the inversion closest to your hand and a progression barely moves. G, E minor, C and D all live between frets 2 and 5.
rows.translation: Velg omvendingen nærmest hånden, så beveger akkordrekken seg knapt. G, E-moll, C og D ligger alle mellom bånd 2 og 5.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-4 “Triads through a progression” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: From G at frets 4, 3, 3 to E minor at 4, 5, 3, which notes stay?
rows.translation: Fra G på bånd 4, 3, 3 til E-moll på 4, 5, 3: hvilke toner blir?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-4 “Triads through a progression” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Only D
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-4 “Triads through a progression” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: B and G
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-4 “Triads through a progression” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: B on string 3 and G on string 1 stay put. Only string 2 moves, from D up to E.
rows.translation: B på streng 3 og G på streng 1 blir på plass. Bare streng 2 flyttes, fra D opp til E.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-4 “Triads through a progression” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Higher up the neck
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-4 “Triads through a progression” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: The same four chords sit higher too: G at frets 7, 8 and 7, E minor at 9, 8 and 7, C at 9, 8 and 8, and D at 7, 7 and 5.
rows.translation: De samme fire akkordene ligger også høyere: G på bånd 7, 8 og 7, E-moll på 9, 8 og 7, C på 9, 8 og 8, og D på 7, 7 og 5.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-4 “Triads through a progression” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Triad arpeggios
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-5 “Triad arpeggios” · title

rows.source: Pick them apart
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-5 “Triad arpeggios” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Play a triad's notes one at a time and you have an arpeggio. Through a progression, the notes make a melody of their own.
rows.translation: Spill tonene i en treklang én om gangen, så har du et arpeggio. Gjennom en akkordrekke danner tonene sin egen melodi.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-5 “Triad arpeggios” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Arpeggios, frets 2 to 5
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-5 “Triad arpeggios” · step 2 (along) · title

rows.source: What is an arpeggio?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-5 “Triad arpeggios” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: A chord played one note at a time
rows.translation: En akkord spilt én tone om gangen
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-5 “Triad arpeggios” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A chord strummed twice
rows.translation: En akkord slått an to ganger
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-5 “Triad arpeggios” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Arpeggios in eighths
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-5 “Triad arpeggios” · step 4 (along) · title

rows.source: Listen to the top
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-5 “Triad arpeggios” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: The top notes here run G, G, G, F sharp: almost still while the chords change under them. A note that two chords share is a common tone, and it's why triads sound so smooth.
rows.translation: Topptonene her går G, G, G, F kryss: nesten stille mens akkordene skifter under. En tone som to akkorder deler, er en fellestone, og det er derfor treklanger låter så smidig.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-5 “Triad arpeggios” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Did the top note go up or down?

rows.source: Song spotlight: Roller Rink
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-spotlight “Song spotlight: Roller Rink” · title

rows.source: Triads on the dance floor
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-spotlight “Song spotlight: Roller Rink” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Roller Rink is a Timbre Original: retro dance pop on G, E minor, C and D, your four triads between frets 2 and 5. Small shapes on the top strings sound bright and tight, like a second guitar. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Roller Rink er en Timbre-original: retropop for dans på G, E-moll, C og D, de fire treklangene dine mellom bånd 2 og 5. Små grep på de øverste strengene låter lyst og stramt, som en ekstra gitar. Hele sangen finnes i Sanger, under Originaler.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-spotlight “Song spotlight: Roller Rink” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Roller Rink's loop is the one, six, four and five of G. Which chord is the six?
rows.translation: Sløyfen i Roller Rink er første, sjette, fjerde og femte trinn i G. Hvilken akkord er sjette?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-spotlight “Song spotlight: Roller Rink” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Count up G major: G 1, A 2, B 3, C 4, D 5, E 6. The chord on 6 is minor: E minor.
rows.translation: Tell opp G-dur: G 1, A 2, B 3, C 4, D 5, E 6. Akkorden på 6 er moll: E-moll.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-spotlight “Song spotlight: Roller Rink” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Triads, top string down
rows.translation: Treklanger fra øverste streng og ned
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-spotlight “Song spotlight: Roller Rink” · step 4 (along) · title

rows.source: Triad challenge
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · challenge gtr-18-6 “Triad challenge” · title

rows.source: Small shapes, whole neck
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · challenge gtr-18-6 “Triad challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: No new ideas: major and minor triads, their inversions, G, E minor, C and D in two places, and the arpeggios. Keep every move small.
rows.translation: Ikke noe nytt: dur- og molltreklanger, omvendingene deres, G, E-moll, C og D på to steder, og arpeggioene. Hold hver bevegelse liten.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · challenge gtr-18-6 “Triad challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: A minor triad is a major triad with…
rows.translation: En molltreklang er en durtreklang med…

rows.source: Major seventh chords
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-1 “Major seventh chords” · title

rows.source: Add the seventh
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-1 “Major seventh chords” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A major seventh chord adds the note one fret below the root's octave. It turns a plain major chord soft and dreamy. Open Cmaj7 is C with finger 1 lifted.
rows.translation: En durakkord med stor septim legger til tonen ett bånd under grunntonens oktav. Den gjør en vanlig durakkord myk og drømmende. Åpen Cmaj7 er C med finger 1 løftet.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-1 “Major seventh chords” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Cmaj7 is C plus which note?
rows.translation: Cmaj7 er C pluss hvilken tone?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-1 “Major seventh chords” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: B flat
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-1 “Major seventh chords” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The major seventh sits one fret below the root's octave: B, just under C.
rows.translation: Den store septimen ligger ett bånd under grunntonens oktav: B, rett under C.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-1 “Major seventh chords” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Fmaj7: free the top string
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-1 “Major seventh chords” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Play the mini F, but let finger 1 press string 2 only. Open string 1, E, is the major seventh of F.
rows.translation: Spill mini-F, men la finger 1 bare trykke streng 2. Åpen streng 1, E, er den store septimen i F.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-1 “Major seventh chords” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Minor seventh chords
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-2 “Minor seventh chords” · title

rows.source: Mellow minor
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-2 “Minor seventh chords” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A minor seventh chord adds the note two frets below the root's octave. It sounds mellow, between dark and bright. Am7 is A minor with finger 3 lifted.
rows.translation: En mollseptimakkord legger til tonen to bånd under grunntonens oktav. Den låter mykt, mellom mørkt og lyst. Am7 er A-moll med finger 3 løftet.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-2 “Minor seventh chords” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Dm7 and Em7
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-2 “Minor seventh chords” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Dm7: finger 2 on string 3, fret 2, and finger 1 flat across strings 2 and 1 at fret 1. Em7: just finger 2 on string 5, fret 2.
rows.translation: Dm7: finger 2 på streng 3, bånd 2, og finger 1 flatt over streng 2 og 1 på bånd 1. Em7: bare finger 2 på streng 5, bånd 2.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-2 “Minor seventh chords” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Am7 is A minor plus which note?
rows.translation: Am7 er A-moll pluss hvilken tone?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-2 “Minor seventh chords” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: The minor seventh sits two frets below the root's octave: G, two frets under A.
rows.translation: Den lille septimen ligger to bånd under grunntonens oktav: G, to bånd under A.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-2 “Minor seventh chords” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Sevenths with the root on string 5
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-3 “Sevenths with the root on string 5” · title

rows.source: Cmaj7 at fret 3
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-3 “Sevenths with the root on string 5” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Finger 1 holds string 5 at fret 3 and lies across to string 1. Finger 3 takes string 4, finger 2 string 3 and finger 4 string 2.
rows.translation: Finger 1 holder streng 5 på bånd 3 og ligger over til streng 1. Finger 3 tar streng 4, finger 2 streng 3 og finger 4 streng 2.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-3 “Sevenths with the root on string 5” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Dm7 and D7 at fret 5
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-3 “Sevenths with the root on string 5” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: Dm7 is your A minor barre with the little finger lifted. D7 is the A-shape barre with fingers 3 and 4 on strings 4 and 2. Both are named after string 5.
rows.translation: Dm7 er A-mollbarréen med lillefingeren løftet. D7 er barréen med A-grep med finger 3 og 4 på streng 4 og 2. Begge får navn fra streng 5.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-3 “Sevenths with the root on string 5” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Dm7 at fret 5. Where is its root?
rows.translation: Dm7 på bånd 5. Hvor er grunntonen?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-3 “Sevenths with the root on string 5” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: String 4, fret 7
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-3 “Sevenths with the root on string 5” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: String 5, fret 5
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-3 “Sevenths with the root on string 5” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: String 1, fret 5
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-3 “Sevenths with the root on string 5” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Like every A-shape chord, it's named after its note on string 5.
rows.translation: Som alle akkorder med A-grep får den navn etter tonen på streng 5.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-3 “Sevenths with the root on string 5” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: The ii–V–I
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-4 “The ii–V–I” · title

rows.source: Two, five, one
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-4 “The ii–V–I” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Jazz's favorite move: the chord on the second note of the key, then the fifth, then home. In C that's Dm7, G7 and Cmaj7.
rows.translation: Jazzens favoritt: akkorden på andre tone i tonearten, så den femte, så hjem. I C er det Dm7, G7 og Cmaj7.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-4 “The ii–V–I” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: G7 as a barre
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-4 “The ii–V–I” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: Play the E7 shape as a barre at fret 3: finger 1 across all six strings, finger 3 on string 5 and finger 2 on string 3. Its root is on string 6.
rows.translation: Spill E7-grepet som barré på bånd 3: finger 1 over alle seks strenger, finger 3 på streng 5 og finger 2 på streng 3. Grunntonen er på streng 6.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-4 “The ii–V–I” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In the key of C, which chord is the ii?
rows.translation: Hvilken akkord er ii i C?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-4 “The ii–V–I” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Count up from C: C is one, D is two. The seventh chord built on D is D minor seven.
rows.translation: Tell opp fra C: C er en, D er to. Septimakkorden bygd på D er D-mollseptim.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-4 “The ii–V–I” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Short and crisp
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-4 “The ii–V–I” · step 7 (explain) · title

rows.source: Jazz players often let each chord ring for just a moment. Squeeze as you strum, ease off right after, and the chords start to swing.
rows.translation: Jazzmusikere lar ofte hver akkord klinge bare et øyeblikk. Trykk til når du slår an, lett straks etterpå, så begynner akkordene å svinge.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-4 “The ii–V–I” · step 7 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Swing comping
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-5 “Swing comping” · title

rows.source: The Charleston
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-5 “Swing comping” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Swing guitarists comp: short chords that answer the band. The Charleston rhythm hits beat one and the swung and of two, then leaves space.
rows.translation: Swinggitarister komper: korte akkorder som svarer bandet. Charleston-rytmen treffer første slag og det svingte og etter to, og lar så rommet stå åpent.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-5 “Swing comping” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: ii–V–I in G
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-5 “Swing comping” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: In G, the two, five, one is Am7, D7 and Gmaj7. Am7 is the E minor seven barre at fret 5; Gmaj7 skips string 5, with its root on string 6, fret 3.
rows.translation: I G er to, fem, en Am7, D7 og Gmaj7. Am7 er E-mollseptimbarréen på bånd 5; Gmaj7 hopper over streng 5, med grunntone på streng 6, bånd 3.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-5 “Swing comping” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Song spotlight: Late Checkout
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-spotlight “Song spotlight: Late Checkout” · title

rows.source: A ii–V–I on a loop
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-spotlight “Song spotlight: Late Checkout” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Late Checkout is a Timbre Original: lo-fi in C on Dm7, G7, Cmaj7 and Am7. That's a ii–V–I, plus the six chord to start it over. Comp it with your barred sevenths and the Charleston. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Late Checkout er en Timbre-original: lo-fi i C på Dm7, G7, Cmaj7 og Am7. Det er en ii–V–I, pluss sjettegradsakkorden for å starte om igjen. Komp med septimbarréene og Charleston-rytmen. Hele sangen finnes i Sanger, under Originaler.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-spotlight “Song spotlight: Late Checkout” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In Late Checkout, which chord is the V?
rows.translation: Hvilken akkord er V i Late Checkout?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-spotlight “Song spotlight: Late Checkout” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Count up C major: C 1, D 2, E 3, F 4, G 5. The seventh chord on G is G7.
rows.translation: Tell opp C-dur: C 1, D 2, E 3, F 4, G 5. Septimakkorden på G er G7.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-spotlight “Song spotlight: Late Checkout” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · challenge gtr-19-6 “Jazz chord challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 “The major scale in position” · title

rows.source: G major in two octaves at fret 2, scale degrees and chords, and the Dorian and Mixolydian modes.
rows.translation: G-dur i to oktaver på bånd 2, skalatrinn og akkorder, og dorisk og miksolydisk skala.

rows.source: The major scale shape
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · title

rows.source: Whole steps and half steps
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A half step is one fret, a whole step two. Every major scale climbs whole, whole, half, whole, whole, whole, half. That pattern gives major its sound.
rows.translation: Et halvtonetrinn er ett bånd, et heltonetrinn to. Alle durskalaer stiger hel, hel, halv, hel, hel, hel, halv. Mønsteret gir dur dens klang.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: G major at fret 2
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: Put finger 1 at fret 2 and give each finger its own fret, up to fret 5. From G on string 6, fret 3, the scale climbs across strings 6, 5 and 4.
rows.translation: Sett finger 1 på bånd 2 og gi hver finger sitt eget bånd, opp til bånd 5. Fra G på streng 6, bånd 3 stiger skalaen over streng 6, 5 og 4.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: String 6: frets 3 and 5, fingers 2 and 4. String 5: frets 2 and 3, fingers 1 and 2.
rows.translation: Streng 6: bånd 3 og 5, finger 2 og 4. Streng 5: bånd 2 og 3, finger 1 og 2.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: String 5, fret 5, then string 4: frets 2, 4 and 5. Home on G.
rows.translation: Streng 5, bånd 5, så streng 4: bånd 2, 4 og 5. Hjem på G.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Where do the half steps fall in a major scale?
rows.translation: Hvor ligger halvtonetrinnene i en durskala?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Between notes 3 and 4, and 7 and 8
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Between every pair
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Between notes 1 and 2
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Whole, whole, half: the first half step is from 3 to 4. Whole, whole, whole, half: the second is from 7 to 8.
rows.translation: Hel, hel, halv: første halvtonetrinn er fra 3 til 4. Hel, hel, hel, halv: det andre er fra 7 til 8.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: One octave, up and down
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 7 (along) · title

rows.source: Two octaves in position
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-2 “Two octaves in position” · title

rows.source: The second octave
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-2 “Two octaves in position” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: The same position carries on: A, B and C on string 3, D and E on string 2, F sharp and G on string 1. Your hand never moves.
rows.translation: Samme posisjon fortsetter: A, B og C på streng 3, D og E på streng 2, F kryss og G på streng 1. Hånden flytter seg aldri.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-2 “Two octaves in position” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: String 3: frets 2, 4, 5. String 2: frets 3, 5. String 1: frets 2, 3.
rows.translation: Streng 3: bånd 2, 4, 5. Streng 2: bånd 3, 5. Streng 1: bånd 2, 3.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-2 “Two octaves in position” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: The top octave
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-2 “Two octaves in position” · step 3 (along) · title

rows.source: In this position, which finger plays fret 5?
rows.translation: Hvilken finger spiller bånd 5 i denne posisjonen?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-2 “Two octaves in position” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Finger 1 sits at fret 2, so fret 5 belongs to finger 4, your little finger.
rows.translation: Finger 1 ligger på bånd 2, så bånd 5 tilhører finger 4, lillefingeren.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-2 “Two octaves in position” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Two octaves, G to G
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-2 “Two octaves in position” · step 5 (along) · title

rows.source: A carol built on the scale
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-2 “Two octaves in position” · step 6 (explain) · title

rows.source: Joy to the World, arranged by Lowell Mason in 1839, opens with the G major scale straight down from the top. You know every note already.
rows.translation: Joy to the World, arrangert av Lowell Mason i 1839, åpner med G-durskalaen rett ned fra toppen. Du kan allerede hver tone.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-2 “Two octaves in position” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Joy to the World, in position
rows.translation: Joy to the World i posisjon
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-2 “Two octaves in position” · step 7 (along) · title

rows.source: Scale degrees and chords
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-3 “Scale degrees and chords” · title

rows.source: Number the notes
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-3 “Scale degrees and chords” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Number the scale from G: G is 1, A is 2, and so on up to F sharp, 7. Musicians use these numbers to talk about melodies and chords in any key.
rows.translation: Nummerer skalaen fra G: G er 1, A er 2, og så videre opp til F kryss, 7. Musikere bruker disse tallene til å snakke om melodier og akkorder i alle tonearter.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-3 “Scale degrees and chords” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In G major, which note is 5?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-3 “Scale degrees and chords” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Count up from G: G 1, A 2, B 3, C 4, D 5.
rows.translation: Tell opp fra G: G 1, A 2, B 3, C 4, D 5.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-3 “Scale degrees and chords” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: A chord on every note
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-3 “Scale degrees and chords” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: Stack every other scale note on each degree and you get the key's chords. Chords on 1, 4 and 5 are major; on 2, 3 and 6 they're minor. In G: G, C and D, then A minor, B minor and E minor.
rows.translation: Stable annenhver skalatone på hvert trinn, så får du toneartens akkorder. Akkorder på 1, 4 og 5 er dur; på 2, 3 og 6 er de moll. I G: G, C og D, så A-moll, B-moll og E-moll.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-3 “Scale degrees and chords” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In G major, which chord is built on 6?
rows.translation: Hvilken akkord bygges på 6 i G-dur?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-3 “Scale degrees and chords” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: The sixth note is E, and chords on 2, 3 and 6 are minor. Stack E, G and B: E minor.
rows.translation: Sjette tone er E, og akkorder på 2, 3 og 6 er moll. Stable E, G og B: E-moll.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-3 “Scale degrees and chords” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: The scale in thirds
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-3 “Scale degrees and chords” · step 7 (along) · title

rows.source: A Dorian
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-4 “A Dorian” · title

rows.source: Same notes, new home
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-4 “A Dorian” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Play G major's notes but treat A as home, and the scale turns minor. This sound is A Dorian, a mode of G major: same position, new starting note.
rows.translation: Spill tonene fra G-dur, men behandle A som hjemme, så blir skalaen mollpreget. Denne klangen er A-dorisk, en modus av G-dur: samme posisjon, ny starttone.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-4 “A Dorian” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Start on A, string 6, fret 5, with finger 4, and climb the same frets to A on string 3.
rows.translation: Start på A, streng 6, bånd 5, med finger 4, og stig på de samme båndene til A på streng 3.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-4 “A Dorian” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Which note makes A Dorian brighter than plain A minor?
rows.translation: Hvilken tone gjør A-dorisk lysere enn vanlig A-moll?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-4 “A Dorian” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: F sharp
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-4 “A Dorian” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Plain A minor has F. Dorian keeps G major's F sharp: a bright spot in a minor scale.
rows.translation: Vanlig A-moll har F. Dorisk beholder F kryss fra G-dur: et lyspunkt i en mollskala.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-4 “A Dorian” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: A Dorian melody
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-4 “A Dorian” · step 5 (along) · title

rows.source: A Dorian melody, flowing
rows.translation: En dorisk melodi i A, med flyt
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-4 “A Dorian” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.source: D Mixolydian
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-5 “D Mixolydian” · title

rows.source: Start on D
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-5 “D Mixolydian” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Now treat D as home. G major's notes from D to D make D Mixolydian: a major scale with its seventh one fret lower. It's all over folk, rock and fiddle tunes.
rows.translation: La nå D være hjemme. Tonene i G-dur fra D til D gir D-miksolydisk: en durskala med septimen ett bånd lavere. Den finnes overalt i folkemusikk, rock og felemelodier.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-5 “D Mixolydian” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: From D on string 5, fret 5, up the same position to D on string 2, fret 3.
rows.translation: Fra D på streng 5, bånd 5, opp i samme posisjon til D på streng 2, bånd 3.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-5 “D Mixolydian” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: D major has C sharp. D Mixolydian has…
rows.translation: D-dur har C kryss. D-miksolydisk har…
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-5 “D Mixolydian” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Mixolydian lowers the seventh by one fret, so G major's C becomes its flavor note.

rows.source: Market Day is a Timbre Original: sunny pop in G with a highlife bounce, the bright guitar music of West Africa. Its hook uses only G major's notes, so it sits inside your second-position scale. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.

rows.source: Market Day's chords are G, B minor, C and D. Which scale degrees are they on?

rows.source: Move your minor pentatonic box from fret 5 down to fret 2 and treat A as home: it turns sweet and major. That's A major pentatonic: A, B, C sharp, E and F sharp.
rows.translation: Flytt mollpentatonboksen fra bånd 5 ned til bånd 2 og la A være hjemme: klangen blir søt og durpreget. Det er A-durpentatonikk: A, B, C kryss, E og F kryss.

rows.source: Country players love hammer-ons inside this box: E to F sharp on string 4, A to B on string 3. Pick the first note, then hammer the second.
rows.translation: Countrymusikere elsker hammer-ons i denne boksen: E til F kryss på streng 4, A til B på streng 3. Slå an første tone, og slå så ned fingeren på den andre.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-2 “Country hammer-ons and slides” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: String 4: pick fret 2, then hammer finger 3 onto fret 4.
rows.translation: Streng 4: slå an bånd 2, og slå så finger 3 ned på bånd 4.

rows.source: Now slide finger 3 on string 3 from fret 4 to fret 6, B up to C sharp, then glide back into the box.
rows.translation: Gli nå finger 3 på streng 3 fra bånd 4 til bånd 6, B opp til C kryss, og gli så tilbake inn i boksen.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-2 “Country hammer-ons and slides” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Finger 3 on string 3, fret 4. Pick, then slide to fret 6 without lifting.
rows.translation: Finger 3 på streng 3, bånd 4. Slå an, og gli så til bånd 6 uten å løfte.

rows.source: A trill flutters between two notes: one pick, then hammer-on, pull-off, over and over. Keep it even before you make it fast.
rows.translation: En trille veksler raskt mellom to toner: ett anslag, så hammer-on, pull-off, om og om igjen. Hold den jevn før du gjør den rask.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-3 “Trills and slides into notes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: String 3: frets 2 and 4. Pick once, then hammer and pull with finger 3.
rows.translation: Streng 3: bånd 2 og 4. Slå an én gang, og bruk så hammer-on og pull-off med finger 3.

rows.source: Start one fret below the note you want and slide up into it as you pick. The target is what counts: land it right on the beat.
rows.translation: Start ett bånd under tonen du vil ha, og gli opp til den mens du slår an. Måltonen er det som teller: land på den akkurat på slaget.

rows.source: The major pentatonic holds C sharp, the third of A7. The minor box's C rubs against it, and that rub is the blues.
rows.translation: Durpentatonikken har C kryss, tersen i A7. C i mollboksen gnisser mot den, og den gnissingen er blues.

rows.source: How songs are built
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-1 “How songs are built” · title

rows.source: Sections
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-1 “How songs are built” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Most songs are built from a few sections: verses that tell the story, a chorus that repeats the hook, and sometimes a bridge for contrast. Knowing the plan keeps you from getting lost.
rows.translation: De fleste sanger bygges av noen få deler: vers som forteller historien, et refreng som gjentar motivet, og av og til en bro som kontrast. Når du kjenner planen, går du deg ikke vill.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-1 “How songs are built” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: What does a chorus usually carry?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-1 “How songs are built” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: The hook everyone sings
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-1 “How songs are built” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The guitar solo
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-1 “How songs are built” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The chorus returns with the same words and tune. It's the part people remember and sing along to.
rows.translation: Refrenget kommer tilbake med samme tekst og melodi. Det er delen folk husker og synger med på.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-1 “How songs are built” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Many older songs use AABA: a tune, the same tune again, a contrasting bridge, then the tune once more. Each section often runs eight bars; here they run four.
rows.translation: Mange eldre sanger bruker AABA: en melodi, samme melodi igjen, en kontrasterende bro, så melodien én gang til. Hver del varer ofte åtte takter; her varer de fire.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-1 “How songs are built” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Hvilken del er broen i AABA-form?

rows.source: Intros and endings
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-2 “Intros and endings” · title

rows.source: Borrow the last line
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-2 “Intros and endings” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: The easiest intro is the song's last line, played before the first verse. It sets the key, the tempo and the mood, and the singer knows exactly where to come in.
rows.translation: Den enkleste introen er sangens siste linje, spilt før første vers. Den angir toneart, tempo og stemning, og sangeren vet akkurat hvor han eller hun skal komme inn.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-2 “Intros and endings” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The tag

rows.source: To end, repeat the last line, often twice more, and let the final chord ring. A tag tells everyone the song is closing.
rows.translation: For å avslutte gjentar du siste linje, ofte to ganger til, og lar siste akkord klinge. En slik avslutning forteller alle at sangen er på vei mot slutten.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-2 “Intros and endings” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Arrangers lift a chorus by changing what the guitar does. Fingerpick the verse softly, then strum the chorus, and the same chords suddenly sound bigger.
rows.translation: Arrangører løfter refrenget ved å endre hva gitaren gjør. Bruk mykt fingerspill i verset, og slå så an refrenget, så låter de samme akkordene plutselig større.

rows.source: Down by the Riverside, a spiritual first printed in 1918, gets the full treatment: a Travis-picked intro, two verses and choruses, a pentatonic solo, and a tag.

rows.source: Song spotlight: Jukebox Moon

rows.source: AABA, fifties style
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-spotlight “Song spotlight: Jukebox Moon” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Jukebox Moon is a Timbre Original: a fifties slow dance in AABA form, a verse, the verse again, a bridge on F, then the verse once more. Strum every beat, with a quick swung up into each new bar. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Jukebox Moon er en Timbre-original: en rolig femtitallsdans i AABA-form, et vers, verset igjen, en bro på F, så verset én gang til. Slå an hvert slag, med et raskt, svingt oppslag inn i hver ny takt. Hele sangen finnes i Sanger, under Originaler.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-spotlight “Song spotlight: Jukebox Moon” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: On most instruments the strings get lower as you go up. On ukulele, string 4 (G) is higher than string 3 (C). This is called re-entrant tuning.
rows.translation: På de fleste instrumenter blir strengene dypere når du går oppover. På ukulele er streng 4 (G) høyere enn streng 3 (C). Dette kalles reentrant stemming.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 1 · lesson uke-1-3 “The high G string” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which sounds higher?

rows.source: Why it's tuned that way
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 1 · lesson uke-1-3 “The high G string” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: The high G keeps every chord close together and bright. It is the sweet, ringing sound people know as ukulele.
rows.translation: Den høye G-en holder tonene i hver akkord tett samlet og lyse. Det gir den søte, klingende lyden folk kjenner som ukulele.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 1 · lesson uke-1-3 “The high G string” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Put your second finger on fret 2 of string 4 and strum all four strings. A minor sounds darker than C.
rows.translation: Sett andre finger på bånd 2 på streng 4 og slå an alle fire strenger. A-moll låter mørkere enn C.

rows.source: First finger on fret 1 of string 2, second finger on fret 2 of string 4. Strings 3 and 1 ring open.
rows.translation: Første finger på bånd 1 på streng 2, andre finger på bånd 2 på streng 4. Streng 3 og 1 klinger åpne.

rows.source: G7, the chord that leads home

rows.source: G7: a triangle of fingers
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-4 “G7, the chord that leads home” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: First finger on fret 1 of string 2, second on fret 2 of string 3, third on fret 2 of string 1. Strum all four.
rows.translation: Første finger på bånd 1 på streng 2, andre på bånd 2 på streng 3, tredje på bånd 2 på streng 1. Slå an alle fire.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-4 “G7, the chord that leads home” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: A chord that wants to go home

rows.source: G7 sounds unfinished. Play C after it and the tension lets go. That pull is why so many songs put G7 before C.
rows.translation: G7 låter uavsluttet. Spill C etterpå, så slipper spenningen. Dette draget er grunnen til at så mange sanger setter G7 før C.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-4 “G7, the chord that leads home” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Does this end at home or leave you hanging?

rows.source: C, A minor, F, G7 and G cover hundreds of songs. Make each shape clean, then keep the beat as you change.
rows.translation: C, A-moll, F, G7 og G dekker hundrevis av sanger. Få hvert grep rent, og hold så takten når du bytter.

rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-1 “Steady down strums” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Strum down on every beat: 1, 2, 3, 4. Use the nail of your index finger. When you change chords, your hand keeps moving.
rows.translation: Slå ned på hvert slag: 1, 2, 3, 4. Bruk pekefingerneglen. Når du bytter akkord, fortsetter hånden å bevege seg.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-1 “Steady down strums” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: What should your hand do while you change chords?
rows.translation: Hva bør hånden gjøre mens du bytter akkord?

rows.source: Keep the beat going
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-1 “Steady down strums” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A late chord is better than a broken beat. Keep strumming, even if a string buzzes.
rows.translation: En sen akkord er bedre enn en brutt takt. Fortsett å slå an, selv om en streng skurrer.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-1 “Steady down strums” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Up strums live between beats
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-2 “Down and up” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Count 1 and 2 and 3 and 4 and. Strum down on the numbers, up on each and. Your hand never stops moving.
rows.translation: Tell 1 og 2 og 3 og 4 og. Slå ned på tallene, opp på hvert og. Hånden stopper aldri.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-2 “Down and up” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Lighter on the way up
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-2 “Down and up” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: Up strums mostly catch strings 1 and 2. Brush them with the pad of your finger, a little softer than the downs.
rows.translation: Oppslag treffer stort sett streng 1 og 2. Stryk over dem med fingerputen, litt svakere enn nedslagene.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-2 “Down and up” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Down on 1, down-up on 2, down on 3, down-up on 4. Your hand still swings up after 1 and 3; it just misses the strings.
rows.translation: Ned på 1, ned-opp på 2, ned på 3, ned-opp på 4. Hånden svinger fortsatt opp etter 1 og 3; den bare bommer på strengene.

rows.source: The island strum
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 3 · lesson uke-3-4 “The island strum” · title

rows.source: Down on 1, down-up on 2, skip the down on 3, then up, down-up. The missing down gives it a lilt.
rows.translation: Ned på 1, ned-opp på 2, hopp over nedslaget på 3, så opp, ned-opp. Det manglende nedslaget gir en vuggende rytme.

rows.source: Which strum do you skip in the island strum?
rows.translation: Hvilket anslag hopper du over i øy-anslaget?

rows.source: Your hand still moves down on 3, it just misses the strings. That keeps the up after it in time.
rows.translation: Hånden går fortsatt ned på 3, den treffer bare ikke strengene. Det holder oppslaget etterpå i takt.

rows.source: The last up strum of a bar can be loose or open. Use it to move to the next chord, so beat 1 lands clean.
rows.translation: Siste oppslag i en takt kan være løst eller åpent. Bruk det til å flytte til neste akkord, så slag 1 lander rent.

rows.translation: C D E F G A B C. Start på åpen streng 3 og stig over streng 2 og 1. Hver tone ligger innenfor de tre første båndene.

rows.translation: Andre finger på bånd 2 på streng 4, tredje på bånd 2 på streng 3, første på bånd 1 på streng 2. Streng 1 klinger åpen.

rows.source: First finger on fret 2 of string 1, second on fret 3 of string 2, third on fret 4 of string 3. String 4 rings open.

rows.source: D: three in a row
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 5 · lesson uke-5-3 “D and A” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Put fingers 1, 2 and 3 side by side on fret 2 of strings 4, 3 and 2. String 1 rings open.
rows.translation: Sett finger 1, 2 og 3 ved siden av hverandre på bånd 2 på streng 4, 3 og 2. Streng 1 klinger åpen.

rows.source: Second finger on fret 2 of string 4, first finger on fret 1 of string 3. Strings 2 and 1 ring open.
rows.translation: Andre finger på bånd 2 på streng 4, første finger på bånd 1 på streng 3. Streng 2 og 1 klinger åpne.
