rows.source: Home, away, and back
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-1 “I, IV and V” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: I feels like home. IV moves away. V builds tension that pulls back to I. That trip, out and back again, shapes a huge number of songs.
rows.translation: I føles som hjemme. IV går bort. V bygger spenning som trekker tilbake til I. Denne turen, ut og hjem igjen, former svært mange sanger.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-1 “I, IV and V” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which chord pulls most strongly back to I?
rows.translation: Hvilken akkord trekker sterkest tilbake til I?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-1 “I, IV and V” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: V builds tension that resolves to I.
rows.translation: V bygger spenning som løses opp til I.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-1 “I, IV and V” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: In D major, which chord is IV?

rows.source: Play or sing the roots of I, IV, V, I in C: C, F, G, C.

rows.source: The pop progression
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-2 “The pop progression” · title

rows.source: This four-chord loop runs under a huge number of pop songs. In C major it's C, G, A minor, F. The minor vi adds a touch of shade before IV lifts back toward home.
rows.translation: Denne sløyfen på fire akkorder ligger under svært mange poplåter. I C-dur er det C, G, A-moll, F. Mollakkorden vi gir litt skygge før IV løfter tilbake mot hjemme.

rows.source: Same chords, new start
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-2 “The pop progression” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Start the same loop on vi and you get vi–IV–I–V: A minor, F, C, G. The chords are identical, but beginning on minor makes it sound more serious.
rows.translation: Start samme sløyfe på vi, så får du vi–IV–I–V: A-moll, F, C, G. Akkordene er like, men å begynne på moll gir en mer alvorlig klang.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-2 “The pop progression” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In F major, which chord is vi?
rows.translation: Hvilken akkord er vi i F-dur?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-2 “The pop progression” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: F, G, A, B♭, C, D: the sixth note is D, and vi is minor.
rows.translation: F, G, A, B♭, C, D: sjette tone er D, og vi er moll.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-2 “The pop progression” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Play or sing the roots of I–V–vi–IV in C: C, G, A, F.
rows.translation: Spill eller syng grunntonene i I–V–vi–IV i C: C, G, A, F.

rows.source: The jazz workhorse
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-3 “ii–V–I” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: ii–V–I is the most common progression in jazz. In C major: D minor, G, C. Each root falls a fifth to the next, so the move feels like coming home.
rows.translation: ii–V–I er den vanligste akkordrekken i jazz. I C-dur: D-moll, G, C. Hver grunntone faller en kvint til neste, så bevegelsen føles som å komme hjem.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-3 “ii–V–I” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In C major, what is ii–V–I?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-3 “ii–V–I” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: D minor, G, C
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-3 “ii–V–I” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: E minor, G, C
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-3 “ii–V–I” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: ii is D minor, V is G, and I is C.
rows.translation: ii er D-moll, V er G og I er C.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-3 “ii–V–I” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Add sevenths
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-3 “ii–V–I” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Jazz players usually add sevenths: Dm7, G7, Cmaj7. The extra notes make each move even smoother. The roots and the trip home stay the same.
rows.translation: Jazzmusikere legger vanligvis til septimer: Dm7, G7, Cmaj7. Ekstratonene gjør hver bevegelse enda smidigere. Grunntonene og veien hjem er de samme.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-3 “ii–V–I” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In F major, what is ii–V–I?

rows.source: G minor, C, F

rows.source: F, G, A, B♭, C: ii is G minor and V is C.

rows.source: Twelve bars
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-4 “The 12-bar blues” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: The 12-bar blues is a chord plan, twelve bars long, behind countless blues, rock and jazz tunes. It uses I, IV and V, often all as dominant seventh chords for a bluesy edge.
rows.translation: 12-taktersbluesen er en akkordplan på tolv takter bak utallige blues-, rocke- og jazzmelodier. Den bruker I, IV og V, ofte alle som dominantseptimakkorder for et bluespreg.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-4 “The 12-bar blues” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Is this the 12-bar blues?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-4 “The 12-bar blues” · step 2 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.source: The plan
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-4 “The 12-bar blues” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: Four bars of I. Two of IV, two of I. One of V, one of IV, two of I. Then it repeats. In A: A7 four times, D7 twice, A7 twice, E7, D7, A7 twice.
rows.translation: Fire takter I. To IV, to I. Én V, én IV, to I. Så gjentas det. I A: A7 fire ganger, D7 to ganger, A7 to ganger, E7, D7, A7 to ganger.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-4 “The 12-bar blues” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-4 “The 12-bar blues” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Four bars of I, then IV arrives in bar 5.
rows.translation: Fire takter I, så kommer IV i takt 5.

rows.source: Bar 9 is the one bar of V, before IV in bar 10.
rows.translation: Takt 9 er den ene takten V, før IV i takt 10.

rows.translation: Hva er de tre bluesakkordene i E?

rows.translation: I E er I E, IV er A og V er B.

rows.translation: Spill eller syng grunntonene i blues i A: A, D, E, tilbake til A.

rows.source: Cadences
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-5 “Cadences” · title

rows.source: A cadence is the chord move that ends a phrase, like punctuation. V to I is the strongest, a full stop. It's called an authentic cadence.
rows.translation: En kadens er akkordbevegelsen som avslutter en frase, som tegnsetting. V til I er sterkest, et punktum. Den kalles en autentisk kadens.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-5 “Cadences” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Does this phrase sound finished?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-5 “Cadences” · step 2 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.source: Other endings
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-5 “Cadences” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: IV to I is a plagal cadence, the soft amen at the end of many hymns. Stopping on V is a half cadence, like a comma. V to vi is deceptive: you expect home and get a surprise.
rows.translation: IV til I er en plagal kadens, det myke amen i slutten av mange salmer. Å stoppe på V er en halvslutning, som et komma. V til vi er skuffende: du venter hjemme, men blir overrasket.

rows.source: Rhythm
rows.context: Rhythm course · title

rows.source: Feel the beat, count it, and tap it in time
rows.translation: Kjenn pulsen, tell og trykk i takt
rows.context: Rhythm course · course subtitle

rows.source: Find the pulse, count to four, and tap in time.
rows.translation: Finn pulsen, tell til fire og trykk i takt.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 “The beat” · unit summary

rows.source: Find the pulse
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-1 “Find the pulse” · title

rows.source: The beat is a steady pulse
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-1 “Find the pulse” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: The beat is the steady pulse you tap your foot to. It never rushes or drags, like footsteps on an easy walk. Every rhythm sits on top of it.
rows.translation: Takten er den jevne pulsen du tramper til. Den verken skynder seg eller henger etter, som skritt på en rolig tur. Hver rytme ligger oppå den.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-1 “Find the pulse” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Tap with the click
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-1 “Find the pulse” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: Hold your fingertip just above the screen and tap each time the click sounds. Let it bounce off the glass like a drumstick. Aim to land with the click, not after it.
rows.translation: Hold fingertuppen rett over skjermen og trykk hver gang klikket høres. La den sprette fra glasset som en trommestikke. Sikt mot å treffe med klikket, ikke etter.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-1 “Find the pulse” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: How does a beat feel?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-1 “Find the pulse” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Steady and even
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-1 “Find the pulse” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Fast, then slow
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-1 “Find the pulse” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Loud, then quiet
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-1 “Find the pulse” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A beat keeps the same space between pulses, like a clock ticking.
rows.translation: En puls har samme avstand mellom slagene, som en tikkende klokke.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-1 “Find the pulse” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: How many clicks did you hear?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-1 “Find the pulse” · step 5 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.source: Count to four
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-2 “Count to four” · title

rows.source: Count out loud: 1, 2, 3, 4
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-2 “Count to four” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Most music groups beats in fours. Count 1, 2, 3, 4 out loud with the click, then start again at 1. Saying the numbers helps your hands keep time.
rows.translation: Det meste av musikken samler slag i grupper på fire. Tell 1, 2, 3, 4 høyt med klikket, og start så igjen på 1. Å si tallene hjelper hendene å holde takten.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-2 “Count to four” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Bars and beat 1
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-2 “Count to four” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: A bar is one group of beats. Here each bar holds four beats, written 4/4. Beat 1 starts every bar, so lean on it a little as you count.
rows.translation: En takt er én gruppe slag. Her har hver takt fire slag, skrevet 4/4. Slag 1 starter hver takt, så legg litt vekt på det når du teller.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-2 “Count to four” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The strong click is beat 1. How many beats are in each bar?
rows.translation: Det sterke klikket er slag 1. Hvor mange slag er det i hver takt?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-2 “Count to four” · step 4 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.source: Which beat starts every bar?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-2 “Count to four” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Beat 2
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-2 “Count to four” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Counting starts again at 1 at the top of every bar.
rows.translation: Tellingen starter igjen på 1 i begynnelsen av hver takt.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-2 “Count to four” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Quarter notes and longer
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-3 “Quarter notes and longer” · title

rows.source: A note that lasts one beat is a quarter note. Four of them fill a bar of 4/4, so tapping on every beat means tapping quarter notes.
rows.translation: En note som varer ett slag, er en firedel. Fire fyller en takt i 4/4, så å trykke på hvert slag er å trykke firedeler.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-3 “Quarter notes and longer” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Count more than you tap
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-3 “Quarter notes and longer” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: Now tap only on 1 and 3. Each tap is a half note, two beats long. Keep counting all four; the beats you skip still happen.
rows.translation: Trykk nå bare på 1 og 3. Hvert trykk er en halvnote, to slag lang. Fortsett å telle alle fire; slagene du hopper over, skjer fortsatt.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-3 “Quarter notes and longer” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: You tap on 1 and 3. What happens on 2 and 4?
rows.translation: Du trykker på 1 og 3. Hva skjer på 2 og 4?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-3 “Quarter notes and longer” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: You keep counting
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-3 “Quarter notes and longer” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The music stops
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-3 “Quarter notes and longer” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: You tap twice as fast
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-3 “Quarter notes and longer” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The beat never stops. You count through the beats you don't tap.
rows.translation: Pulsen stopper aldri. Du teller gjennom slagene du ikke trykker på.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-3 “Quarter notes and longer” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: A whole note: just beat 1
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-3 “Quarter notes and longer” · step 6 (explain) · title

rows.source: A whole note lasts all four beats. Tap once on 1 and count 2, 3, 4 under your breath so the next 1 lands on time.
rows.translation: En helnote varer alle fire slag. Trykk én gang på 1 og tell 2, 3, 4 lavt for deg selv, så neste 1 lander i tide.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-3 “Quarter notes and longer” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Tempo is the speed of the beat
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-4 “Tempo” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Tempo is how fast the beat goes, counted in beats per minute, or bpm. At 60 bpm the beat comes once a second, like a clock.
rows.translation: Tempo er hvor fort pulsen går, telt i slag per minutt, eller bpm. Ved 60 bpm kommer slaget én gang i sekundet, som en klokke.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-4 “Tempo” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: At 60 bpm, how often does the beat come?
rows.translation: Hvor ofte kommer slaget ved 60 bpm?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-4 “Tempo” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Twice a second
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-4 “Tempo” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Once a second
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-4 “Tempo” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Once every two seconds
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-4 “Tempo” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: 60 beats in 60 seconds is one beat each second.
rows.translation: 60 slag på 60 sekunder er ett slag hvert sekund.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-4 “Tempo” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Smaller as it speeds up
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-4 “Tempo” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Faster tempos need less effort, not more. Keep your hand loose and tap from the knuckle, not the wrist or shoulder.
rows.translation: Raskere tempo trenger mindre innsats, ikke mer. Hold hånden løs og trykk fra knoken, ikke håndleddet eller skulderen.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-4 “Tempo” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The tempo goes up. What should your taps do?
rows.translation: Tempoet øker. Hva bør trykkene dine gjøre?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-4 “Tempo” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Get bigger and harder
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-4 “Tempo” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Wait a little behind the click
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-4 “Tempo” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Stay small and light
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-4 “Tempo” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Small, relaxed motions are quicker and easier to keep even.
rows.translation: Små, avslappede bevegelser er raskere og lettere å holde jevne.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-4 “Tempo” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Steady hands
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · challenge rhy-1-5 “Steady hands” · title

rows.source: This challenge mixes beats, bars, longer notes and tempo. Count out loud the whole way, and keep your taps small and relaxed.
rows.translation: Denne utfordringen blander slag, takter, lengre noter og tempo. Tell høyt hele veien, og hold trykkene små og avslappede.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · challenge rhy-1-5 “Steady hands” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which note lasts a whole bar of 4/4?
rows.translation: Hvilken note varer en hel takt i 4/4?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · challenge rhy-1-5 “Steady hands” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: A whole note lasts four beats, the full bar of 4/4.
rows.translation: En helnote varer fire slag, hele takten i 4/4.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · challenge rhy-1-5 “Steady hands” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: What does 90 bpm mean?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · challenge rhy-1-5 “Steady hands” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: 90 beats every minute
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · challenge rhy-1-5 “Steady hands” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: 90 bars every minute
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · challenge rhy-1-5 “Steady hands” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: 90 taps in each bar
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · challenge rhy-1-5 “Steady hands” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: bpm counts beats per minute, so 90 bpm is one and a half beats each second.
rows.translation: bpm teller slag per minutt, så 90 bpm er halvannet slag hvert sekund.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · challenge rhy-1-5 “Steady hands” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Split each beat in two and count "and."
rows.translation: Del hvert slag i to og tell “og”.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 “Eighth notes” · unit summary

rows.source: Two taps per beat
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-1 “Two taps per beat” · title

rows.source: Split the beat in two
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-1 “Two taps per beat” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: An eighth note lasts half a beat, so two fit in every beat. Eight of them fill a bar of 4/4.
rows.translation: En åttedel varer et halvt slag, så det er plass til to i hvert slag. Åtte fyller en takt i 4/4.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-1 “Two taps per beat” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Count 1 and 2 and
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-1 “Two taps per beat” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: Say the number on each beat and "and" exactly halfway between: 1 and 2 and 3 and 4 and. Tap on every word.
rows.translation: Si tallet på hvert slag og “og” nøyaktig midt imellom: 1 og 2 og 3 og 4 og. Trykk på hvert ord.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-1 “Two taps per beat” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: An eighth note is half a beat, so two fill each beat.
rows.translation: En åttedel er et halvt slag, så to fyller hvert slag.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-1 “Two taps per beat” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: The strong clicks are the beats. How many beats did you hear?
rows.translation: De sterke klikkene er slagene. Hvor mange slag hørte du?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-1 “Two taps per beat” · step 5 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.source: Quarters and eighths
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-2 “Quarters and eighths” · title

rows.source: Mix long and short
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-2 “Quarters and eighths” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Now some beats get one tap and some get two. Keep saying every "and," even the ones you don't tap.
rows.translation: Nå får noen slag ett trykk og noen to. Fortsett å si hvert “og”, også dem du ikke trykker på.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-2 “Quarters and eighths” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: How do you count this pattern?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-2 “Quarters and eighths” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-2 “Quarters and eighths” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-2 “Quarters and eighths” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-2 “Quarters and eighths” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Beat 1 has two taps, 1 and. Beats 2, 3 and 4 get one tap each.
rows.translation: Slag 1 har to trykk, 1 og. Slag 2, 3 og 4 får ett trykk hver.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-2 “Quarters and eighths” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Read the counts
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-3 “Read the counts” · title

rows.source: Every tap has a name
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-3 “Read the counts” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: In eighths, each tap lands on a number or an "and." Before you tap a new pattern, say its counts once out loud.
rows.translation: I åttedeler lander hvert trykk på et tall eller et “og”. Før du trykker et nytt mønster, si tellingen høyt én gang.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-3 “Read the counts” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which counts match this pattern?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-3 “Read the counts” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: 1, 2 and, 3 and 4
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-3 “Read the counts” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: 1 and 2, 3 and 4
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-3 “Read the counts” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: 1 and 2 and 3 and 4
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-3 “Read the counts” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Beats 1 and 3 have two taps each; beats 2 and 4 have one.
rows.translation: Slag 1 og 3 har to trykk hver; slag 2 og 4 har ett.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-3 “Read the counts” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: 1, 2 and 3 and 4
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-3 “Read the counts” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: 1 and 2, 3, 4 and
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-3 “Read the counts” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: 1, 2, 3 and 4 and
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-3 “Read the counts” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Beat 1 has one tap, beats 2 and 3 have two, and beat 4 has one.
rows.translation: Slag 1 har ett trykk, slag 2 og 3 har to, og slag 4 har ett.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-3 “Read the counts” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Even eighths
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-4 “Even eighths” · title

rows.source: Make both halves equal
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-4 “Even eighths” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: The "and" should land exactly halfway between beats. If your eighths sound like a gallop, slow down and say the counts as you tap.
rows.translation: “Og” skal lande nøyaktig midt mellom slagene. Hvis åttedelene låter som galopp, senk tempoet og tell mens du trykker.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-4 “Even eighths” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Your eighths sound uneven. What helps most?
rows.translation: Åttedelene dine låter ujevnt. Hva hjelper mest?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-4 “Even eighths” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Slow down and count out loud
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-4 “Even eighths” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Tap harder on each beat
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-4 “Even eighths” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Speed up until it smooths out
rows.translation: Øk tempoet til det blir jevnt
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-4 “Even eighths” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Slowing down gives you time to place each "and" in the middle. Counting keeps it there.
rows.translation: Lavere tempo gir tid til å plassere hvert “og” i midten. Tellingen holder det der.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-4 “Even eighths” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Keep your fingertip close
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-4 “Even eighths” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Hover just above the glass between taps. A short, light motion is easier to keep even at faster tempos.
rows.translation: Hold fingeren rett over glasset mellom trykkene. En kort, lett bevegelse er lettere å holde jevn i høyere tempo.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · lesson rhy-2-4 “Even eighths” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Eighth-note check
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · challenge rhy-2-5 “Eighth-note check” · title

rows.source: This challenge mixes quarters and eighths. Say each pattern's counts once, then tap it with every "and" right in the middle.
rows.translation: Denne utfordringen blander firedeler og åttedeler. Si tellingen i hvert mønster én gang, og trykk det så med hvert “og” midt imellom.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · challenge rhy-2-5 “Eighth-note check” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: 1 and 2 and 3, 4
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 2 · challenge rhy-2-5 “Eighth-note check” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Rests and syncopation
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 “Rests and syncopation” · title

rows.source: Leave space on purpose, then tap between the beats.
rows.translation: La det være rom med vilje, og trykk så mellom slagene.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 “Rests and syncopation” · unit summary

rows.source: Rests are counted
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-1 “Rests are counted” · title

rows.source: A rest is counted silence
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-1 “Rests are counted” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A rest is a silence with a set length. You still count it; you just don't tap. A quarter rest lasts one beat.
rows.translation: En pause er stillhet med fast varighet. Du teller fortsatt; du bare trykker ikke. En firedelspause varer ett slag.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-1 “Rests are counted” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: What do you do on a rest?
rows.translation: Hva gjør du i en pause?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-1 “Rests are counted” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Skip to the next note
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-1 “Rests are counted” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Tap softly
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-1 “Rests are counted” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Count it silently
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-1 “Rests are counted” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A rest takes up time just like a note. Counting it keeps your place.
rows.translation: En pause tar tid akkurat som en tone. Å telle den holder deg på plass.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-1 “Rests are counted” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Rest on beat 1
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-1 “Rests are counted” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Leaving beat 1 empty is the hardest rest. Nod your head on 1 so you feel it without tapping, then come in on 2.
rows.translation: Det vanskeligste er å la slag 1 være tomt. Nikk på 1 så du kjenner det uten å trykke, og kom så inn på 2.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-1 “Rests are counted” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Tap the and
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-2 “Tap the and” · title

rows.source: Rest, then tap the and
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-2 “Tap the and” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: An eighth rest lasts half a beat. Count 1 and 2 and, rest on 2, and tap its "and" instead. It feels like a small push into beat 3.
rows.translation: En åttedelspause varer et halvt slag. Tell 1 og 2 og, hvil på 2 og trykk på dens “og” i stedet. Det føles som et lite skyv inn i slag 3.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-2 “Tap the and” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Where is the second tap?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-2 “Tap the and” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: On beat 2
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-2 “Tap the and” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: On the "and" of 2
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-2 “Tap the and” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: On beat 3
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-2 “Tap the and” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: It sits halfway between beats 2 and 3, on the "and" of 2.
rows.translation: Det ligger midt mellom slag 2 og 3, på “og” etter 2.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-2 “Tap the and” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Syncopation
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-3 “Syncopation” · title

rows.source: Syncopation: off the beat
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-3 “Syncopation” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Syncopation puts a strong note between the beats, where your ear doesn't expect one. It makes a rhythm lean forward.
rows.translation: Synkopering legger en sterk tone mellom slagene, der øret ikke venter den. Det får rytmen til å trekke fremover.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-3 “Syncopation” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Count every eighth
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-3 “Syncopation” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: This pattern lands on 1, the "and" of 2, and 4. Count 1 and 2 and 3 and 4 and, and tap only those three spots.
rows.translation: Dette mønsteret lander på 1, “og” etter 2 og 4. Tell 1 og 2 og 3 og 4 og, og trykk bare på de tre stedene.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-3 “Syncopation” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Count the clicks from 1 to 8. Where do the strong ones fall?
rows.translation: Tell klikkene fra 1 til 8. Hvor faller de sterke?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-3 “Syncopation” · step 4 (listen) · question or instruction
Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-3 “Syncopation” · step 4 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.source: 1, 4 and 7
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-3 “Syncopation” · step 4 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.source: 1 and 5
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-3 “Syncopation” · step 4 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.source: What makes a rhythm syncopated?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-3 “Syncopation” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Notes only on beat 1
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-3 “Syncopation” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Strong notes between the beats
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-3 “Syncopation” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Syncopation shifts the weight off the beat, onto an "and" or a weak beat.
rows.translation: Synkopering flytter vekten fra slaget til et “og” eller et svakt slag.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-3 “Syncopation” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Offbeats
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-4 “Offbeats” · title

rows.source: Tap only the ands
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-4 “Offbeats” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Offbeats are the "and" between beats. Nod on the numbers and tap only the ands, like the chop of a reggae guitar.
rows.translation: Mellomslag er “og” mellom slagene. Nikk på tallene og trykk bare på og-slagene, som korte anslag fra en reggaegitar.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-4 “Offbeats” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The first click is beat 1. Are the strong clicks on the numbers or the ands?
rows.translation: Første klikk er slag 1. Er de sterke klikkene på tallene eller og-slagene?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-4 “Offbeats” · step 3 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.source: On the numbers
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-4 “Offbeats” · step 3 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.source: On the ands
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-4 “Offbeats” · step 3 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.source: Where do offbeats land?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-4 “Offbeats” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Between the beats, on the "and"
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-4 “Offbeats” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: On every beat
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-4 “Offbeats” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Offbeats fall halfway between the beats, on every "and."
rows.translation: Mellomslag faller midt mellom slagene, på hvert “og”.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · lesson rhy-3-4 “Offbeats” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Space and push
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · challenge rhy-3-5 “Space and push” · title

rows.source: This challenge mixes rests, the "and" on its own, syncopation and offbeats. Count every eighth out loud, even when you don't tap.
rows.translation: Denne utfordringen blander pauser, “og” alene, synkopering og mellomslag. Tell hver åttedel høyt, også når du ikke trykker.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · challenge rhy-3-5 “Space and push” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which of these is syncopated?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · challenge rhy-3-5 “Space and push” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: 1 and 2 and 3 and 4 and
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · challenge rhy-3-5 “Space and push” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: 1, the "and" of 2, 4
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · challenge rhy-3-5 “Space and push” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Tapping the "and" of 2 and skipping 3 moves the weight off the beat.
rows.translation: Å trykke på “og” etter 2 og hoppe over 3 flytter vekten fra slaget.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · challenge rhy-3-5 “Space and push” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: 1, 3 and 6
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 3 · challenge rhy-3-5 “Space and push” · step 6 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.source: Ties and dots
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 “Ties and dots” · title

rows.source: Hold notes across the beat with ties and dotted rhythms.
rows.translation: Hold toner over slaget med bindebuer og punkterte rytmer.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 “Ties and dots” · unit summary

rows.source: Ties
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-1 “Ties” · title

rows.source: A tie joins two notes
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-1 “Ties” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A tie is a curved line joining two notes. You play the first and hold it through the second, so the tied note gets no new tap.
rows.translation: En bindebue er en buet linje mellom to noter. Du spiller den første og holder gjennom den andre, så den bundne tonen ikke får et nytt trykk.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-1 “Ties” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Beat 2 is tied to beat 3. What do you do on 3?
rows.translation: Slag 2 er bundet til slag 3. Hva gjør du på 3?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-1 “Ties” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Keep holding, no new tap
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-1 “Ties” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Tap again
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-1 “Ties” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Stop the sound and wait
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-1 “Ties” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A tie stretches one note. You count 3, but the note from beat 2 keeps sounding.
rows.translation: En bindebue forlenger én tone. Du teller 3, men tonen fra slag 2 klinger videre.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-1 “Ties” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Tie across the beat
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-1 “Ties” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Tie the "and" of 2 into beat 3. Tap on the "and," then let beat 3 pass while the note rings. It's syncopation, written another way.
rows.translation: Bind “og” etter 2 inn i slag 3. Trykk på “og”, og la så slag 3 passere mens tonen klinger. Det er synkopering, skrevet på en annen måte.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-1 “Ties” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: What a dot does
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-2 “What a dot does” · title

rows.source: A dot adds half
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-2 “What a dot does” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A dot after a note adds half its length. A half note lasts two beats, so a dotted half lasts three. Tap 1, count 2 and 3, tap 4.
rows.translation: En prikk etter en note legger til halvparten av varigheten. En halvnote varer to slag, så en punktert halvnote varer tre. Trykk 1, tell 2 og 3, trykk 4.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-2 “What a dot does” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: A quarter note lasts one beat. How long is a dotted quarter?
rows.translation: En firedel varer ett slag. Hvor lang er en punktert firedel?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-2 “What a dot does” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Half of one beat is a half beat. Add it and you get one and a half.
rows.translation: Halvparten av ett slag er et halvt slag. Legg det til, så får du halvannet.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-2 “What a dot does” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: The dotted quarter
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-2 “What a dot does” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: A dotted quarter lasts one and a half beats, so the next note lands on an "and." Count 1 and 2 and: tap 1, then the "and" of 2.
rows.translation: En punktert firedel varer halvannet slag, så neste tone lander på et “og”. Tell 1 og 2 og: trykk 1, så “og” etter 2.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-2 “What a dot does” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: You tapped this pattern with a rest in Unit 3. What changes with a dot?
rows.translation: Du trykket dette mønsteret med pause i enhet 3. Hva endres med punktering?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-2 “What a dot does” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: The first note rings longer
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-2 “What a dot does” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The taps move
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-2 “What a dot does” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The tempo slows
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-2 “What a dot does” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The taps land in the same places. Only the length of the first note changes.
rows.translation: Trykkene lander på samme steder. Bare varigheten til første tone endres.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-2 “What a dot does” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Long, short
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-3 “Long, short” · title

rows.source: Dotted quarter, then eighth
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-3 “Long, short” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A dotted quarter plus an eighth fills two beats: long, short. Count 1 and 2 and; tap 1 and the "and" of 2.
rows.translation: En punktert firedel pluss en åttedel fyller to slag: lang, kort. Tell 1 og 2 og; trykk 1 og “og” etter 2.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-3 “Long, short” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: A dotted quarter and an eighth together last how long?
rows.translation: Hvor lenge varer en punktert firedel og en åttedel til sammen?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-3 “Long, short” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Three beats
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-3 “Long, short” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: One and a half plus a half is two.
rows.translation: Halvannet pluss et halvt er to.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-3 “Long, short” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Which lasts as long as a dotted quarter?
rows.translation: Hva varer like lenge som en punktert firedel?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-3 “Long, short” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: A quarter tied to an eighth
rows.translation: En firedel bundet til en åttedel
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-3 “Long, short” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Two eighth notes
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-3 “Long, short” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The tie adds half a beat to the quarter, just like the dot does.
rows.translation: Bindebuen legger et halvt slag til firedelen, akkurat som prikken.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · lesson rhy-4-3 “Long, short” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Held notes
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · challenge rhy-4-4 “Held notes” · title

rows.source: This challenge mixes ties and dots. Count every eighth out loud; a held note still takes up its full time.
rows.translation: Denne utfordringen blander bindebuer og punktering. Tell hver åttedel høyt; en holdt tone tar fortsatt hele sin tid.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · challenge rhy-4-4 “Held notes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: How long is a dotted half note?
rows.translation: Hvor lang er en punktert halvnote?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · challenge rhy-4-4 “Held notes” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: A half note is two beats; the dot adds one more.
rows.translation: En halvnote er to slag; prikken legger til ett til.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · challenge rhy-4-4 “Held notes” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: A tie connects two notes. How many times do you tap?
rows.translation: En bindebue forbinder to noter. Hvor mange ganger trykker du?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · challenge rhy-4-4 “Held notes” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: You tap the first note and hold through the second.
rows.translation: Du trykker på første tone og holder gjennom den andre.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 4 · challenge rhy-4-4 “Held notes” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Triplets and swing
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 “Triplets and swing” · title

rows.source: Split the beat in three, then swing your eighths.
rows.translation: Del slaget i tre, og gi så åttedelene swing.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 “Triplets and swing” · unit summary

rows.source: Three to a beat
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-1 “Three to a beat” · title

rows.source: Triplets split the beat in three
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-1 “Three to a beat” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A triplet fits three even notes into one beat. Count 1-trip-let, 2-trip-let, with each syllable the same length.
rows.translation: En triol gir plass til tre jevne toner i ett slag. Tell 1-tri-ol, 2-tri-ol, med hver stavelse like lang.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-1 “Three to a beat” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: How many triplet notes fit in one beat?
rows.translation: Hvor mange trioltoner får plass i ett slag?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-1 “Three to a beat” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Triplets split each beat into three equal parts.
rows.translation: Trioler deler hvert slag i tre like deler.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-1 “Three to a beat” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Are the clicks in groups of two or three?
rows.translation: Er klikkene i grupper på to eller tre?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-1 “Three to a beat” · step 5 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.source: Groups of two
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-1 “Three to a beat” · step 5 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.source: Groups of three
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-1 “Three to a beat” · step 5 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.source: Switch between two and three
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-2 “Twos and threes” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Eighths split the beat in two; triplets split it in three. The beat itself stays put. Only the way you divide it changes.
rows.translation: Åttedeler deler slaget i to; trioler deler det i tre. Selve pulsen blir stående. Bare måten du deler den på, endres.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-2 “Twos and threes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: You count 1-trip-let, 2-trip-let. What are you tapping?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-2 “Twos and threes” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Triplets
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-2 “Twos and threes” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Three syllables per beat means three notes per beat: triplets.
rows.translation: Tre stavelser per slag betyr tre toner per slag: trioler.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-2 “Twos and threes” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Swing feel
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-3 “Swing feel” · title

rows.source: Swing: long, short
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-3 “Swing feel” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: In swing, each pair of eighths turns long-short. The "and" moves late, onto the last part of a triplet. Think doo-ba, doo-ba.
rows.translation: I swing blir hvert åttedelspar lang-kort. “Og” flyttes sent, til siste del av en triol. Tenk du-ba, du-ba.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-3 “Swing feel” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Skip the middle triplet
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-3 “Swing feel” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: Count 1-trip-let and tap only on "1" and "let." The gap in the middle is the swing.
rows.translation: Tell 1-tri-ol og trykk bare på “1” og “ol”. Mellomrommet i midten er svingen.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-3 “Swing feel” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In swing, where does the "and" land?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-3 “Swing feel” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Exactly halfway
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-3 “Swing feel” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Right after the beat
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-3 “Swing feel” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Late, on the last triplet
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-3 “Swing feel” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Swing delays the "and" to the last triplet, which gives the long-short lilt.
rows.translation: Swing forsinker “og” til siste trioltone og gir den vuggende lang-kort-rytmen.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-3 “Swing feel” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: The ride pattern
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-4 “The ride pattern” · title

rows.source: The jazz ride pattern
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-4 “The ride pattern” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Jazz drummers play this on the ride cymbal: 1, 2, a swung "and," 3, 4, a swung "and." It sounds like ding, ding-a ding.
rows.translation: Jazztrommeslagere spiller dette på ridecymbalen: 1, 2, et svingt “og”, 3, 4, et svingt “og”. Det låter ding, ding-a ding.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-4 “The ride pattern” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: How do you tap a swung "and"?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-4 “The ride pattern” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: On the next beat
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-4 “The ride pattern” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A swung "and" waits for the last triplet of the beat.
rows.translation: Et svingt “og” venter til siste trioltone i slaget.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-4 “The ride pattern” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Straight or swung
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-4 “The ride pattern” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Straight eighths split the beat evenly; swung eighths go long-short. Tap one, then the other, and feel the difference.
rows.translation: Rette åttedeler deler slaget jevnt; svingte går lang-kort. Trykk det ene, så det andre, og kjenn forskjellen.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · lesson rhy-5-4 “The ride pattern” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Threes and swing
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · challenge rhy-5-5 “Threes and swing” · title

rows.source: This challenge mixes triplets, straight eighths and swing. Keep the beat steady while the way you split it changes.
rows.translation: Denne utfordringen blander trioler, rette åttedeler og swing. Hold pulsen jevn mens måten du deler den på, endres.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · challenge rhy-5-5 “Threes and swing” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Swing turns each pair of eighths into what?
rows.translation: Hva gjør swing hvert åttedelspar til?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · challenge rhy-5-5 “Threes and swing” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: The first eighth stretches and the "and" arrives late.
rows.translation: Første åttedel strekkes, og “og” kommer sent.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 5 · challenge rhy-5-5 “Threes and swing” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Other meters
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 “Other meters” · title

rows.source: Waltz in three, march in two, rock in 6/8, and place the accents.
rows.translation: Vals i tre, marsj i to, rock i 6/8 og plassering av betoning.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 “Other meters” · unit summary

rows.source: Waltz time: 3/4
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-1 “Waltz time: 3/4” · title

rows.source: In 3/4 time each bar has three beats: ONE, two, three. It's the waltz. Count 1, 2, 3 and lean on 1.
rows.translation: I 3/4 har hver takt tre slag: EN, to, tre. Det er vals. Tell 1, 2, 3 og legg vekt på 1.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-1 “Waltz time: 3/4” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Long, short in three
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-1 “Waltz time: 3/4” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: A half note fills two of the three beats. Tap 1, count 2, tap 3. It feels like the big step and small step of a waltz.
rows.translation: En halvnote fyller to av de tre slagene. Trykk 1, tell 2, trykk 3. Det føles som valsens store og lille skritt.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-1 “Waltz time: 3/4” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: How many beats are in a bar of 3/4?
rows.translation: Hvor mange slag er det i en takt i 3/4?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-1 “Waltz time: 3/4” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: The top number of a time signature tells you how many beats are in each bar.
rows.translation: Øverste tall i taktarten forteller hvor mange slag det er i hver takt.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-1 “Waltz time: 3/4” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: March time: 2/4
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-2 “March time: 2/4” · title

rows.source: Two beats to a bar
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-2 “March time: 2/4” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: 2/4 has two beats per bar: ONE, two, like marching feet. The bars go by quickly, so beat 1 comes around often.
rows.translation: 2/4 har to slag per takt: EN, to, som marsjerende føtter. Taktene går raskt, så slag 1 kommer ofte.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-2 “March time: 2/4” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which meter feels like a march?
rows.translation: Hvilken taktart føles som en marsj?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-2 “March time: 2/4” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Two beats per bar match left, right, left, right.
rows.translation: To slag per takt passer venstre, høyre, venstre, høyre.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-2 “March time: 2/4” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Six-eight time
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-3 “Six-eight time” · title

rows.source: Six eighths, two groups
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-3 “Six-eight time” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: In 6/8 each bar holds six eighth notes in two groups of three: ONE two three FOUR five six. It feels like two big, rocking beats.
rows.translation: I 6/8 har hver takt seks åttedeler i to grupper på tre: EN to tre FIRE fem seks. Det føles som to store, vuggende slag.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-3 “Six-eight time” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: How does 6/8 usually feel?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-3 “Six-eight time” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Six equal beats, no pattern
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-3 “Six-eight time” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The six eighths fall into two groups of three, so you feel two big beats.
rows.translation: De seks åttedelene faller i to grupper på tre, så du kjenner to store slag.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-3 “Six-eight time” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Long, short in 6/8
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-3 “Six-eight time” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: A favorite 6/8 pattern goes long-short, long-short: tap 1, 3, 4 and 6. It rocks like a lullaby or a sea shanty.
rows.translation: Et vanlig 6/8-mønster går lang-kort, lang-kort: trykk 1, 3, 4 og 6. Det vugger som en vuggesang eller sjanti.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-3 “Six-eight time” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Six clicks per bar. Which meter is this?
rows.translation: Seks klikk per takt. Hvilken taktart er dette?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-3 “Six-eight time” · step 7 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.source: 3/4: three groups of two
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-3 “Six-eight time” · step 7 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.source: 6/8: two groups of three
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-3 “Six-eight time” · step 7 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.source: Accents
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-4 “Accents” · title

rows.source: Accents shape a rhythm
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-4 “Accents” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: An accent is a note played stronger than the ones around it. Move the accents and the feel changes, even when every note stays the same.
rows.translation: En betoning er en tone spilt sterkere enn dem rundt. Flytt betoningene, så endres følelsen, selv når alle tonene er de samme.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-4 “Accents” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Tap only the accents
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-4 “Accents” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: Count all eight eighths and tap just the accents: 1, the "and" of 2, and 4. This 3-3-2 pattern drives a lot of pop and Latin music.
rows.translation: Tell alle åtte åttedeler og trykk bare betoningene: 1, “og” etter 2 og 4. Dette 3-3-2-mønsteret driver mye pop og latinamerikansk musikk.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-4 “Accents” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: What is an accent?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-4 “Accents” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: A note played longer
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-4 “Accents” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A note left out
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-4 “Accents” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A note played stronger
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-4 “Accents” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: An accent is about weight, not length. The note is simply played stronger.
rows.translation: Betoning handler om vekt, ikke varighet. Tonen spilles ganske enkelt sterkere.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-4 “Accents” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: The backbeat
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-4 “Accents” · step 6 (explain) · title

rows.source: Rock, pop and soul put the accent on beats 2 and 4. This is the backbeat. Count all four and tap only 2 and 4, like a snare drum.
rows.translation: Rock, pop og soul betoner slag 2 og 4. Dette er bakslagene. Tell alle fire og trykk bare 2 og 4, som en skarptromme.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-4 “Accents” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The first click is beat 1. Where are the strong clicks?
rows.translation: Første klikk er slag 1. Hvor er de sterke klikkene?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-4 “Accents” · step 8 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.source: On 1 and 3
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-4 “Accents” · step 8 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.source: On 2 and 4
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-4 “Accents” · step 8 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.source: On every click
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-4 “Accents” · step 8 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.source: Every meter
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · challenge rhy-6-5 “Every meter” · title

rows.source: This challenge moves between meters and accents. Before each tap step, count one bar under your breath to find beat 1.
rows.translation: Denne utfordringen veksler mellom taktarter og betoning. Før hver trykkøvelse teller du én takt lavt for deg selv for å finne slag 1.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · challenge rhy-6-5 “Every meter” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Six eighth notes per bar, felt in two groups of three.
rows.translation: Seks åttedeler per takt, følt i to grupper på tre.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · challenge rhy-6-5 “Every meter” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Singing
rows.context: Singing course · title

rows.source: Find your voice and sing in tune
rows.translation: Finn stemmen din og syng rent
rows.context: Singing course · course subtitle

rows.source: Finding your voice
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 “Finding your voice” · title

rows.source: Stand tall, breathe low, hold your first steady note and sing a song.
rows.translation: Stå oppreist, pust dypt, hold din første jevne tone og syng en sang.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 “Finding your voice” · unit summary

rows.source: Stand and breathe
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-1 “Stand and breathe” · title

rows.source: Stand tall, stay loose
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-1 “Stand and breathe” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and knees soft. Let your shoulders drop and your head float up, as if a string lifts it. Keep your jaw loose.
rows.translation: Stå med føttene i hoftebredde og myke knær. La skuldrene synke og hodet løftes, som av en tråd. Hold kjeven avslappet.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-1 “Stand and breathe” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Breathe low
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-1 “Stand and breathe” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: Rest a hand on your belly and breathe in slowly. Your belly and lower ribs widen while your shoulders stay still. That low breath powers your voice.
rows.translation: Legg en hånd på magen og pust langsomt inn. Magen og de nedre ribbeina utvider seg mens skuldrene er i ro. Den dype pusten driver stemmen.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-1 “Stand and breathe” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: When you breathe in to sing, what should move?
rows.translation: Hva skal bevege seg når du puster inn for å synge?
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-1 “Stand and breathe” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Your shoulders
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-1 “Stand and breathe” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Your belly and lower ribs
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-1 “Stand and breathe” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A low breath widens your ribs and belly. Lifting your shoulders tightens your neck and throat.
rows.translation: Dyp pust utvider ribbeina og magen. Å løfte skuldrene strammer nakken og halsen.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-1 “Stand and breathe” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Any octave counts
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-1 “Stand and breathe” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Timbre listens for the note's name, so a C sung low or high both count. Pick the octave that feels easy, never strained.
rows.translation: Timbre lytter etter tonenavnet, så en C sunget lavt eller høyt teller begge. Velg oktaven som føles lett, aldri anstrengt.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-1 “Stand and breathe” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Breathe low, then sing C on "ah" in a comfortable octave. Hold it steady.
rows.translation: Pust dypt, og syng så C på “ah” i en behagelig oktav. Hold den jevn.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-1 “Stand and breathe” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Once more: stand tall, breathe low, and let the note ring.
rows.translation: Én gang til: stå oppreist, pust dypt og la tonen klinge.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-1 “Stand and breathe” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Hold one note
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-2 “Hold one note” · title

rows.source: Sustain with even air
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-2 “Hold one note” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: To sustain is to hold a note at one steady pitch. Let the air out slowly and evenly, like fogging a mirror without stopping.
rows.translation: Å holde en tone betyr å beholde én jevn tonehøyde. Slipp luften ut langsomt og jevnt, som å dugge et speil uten å stoppe.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-2 “Hold one note” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Sing C on "ah" and hold it steady until it locks in.
rows.translation: Syng C på “ah” og hold den jevn til den treffer.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-2 “Hold one note” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Your note wobbles and fades. What helps most?
rows.translation: Tonen skjelver og svinner. Hva hjelper mest?
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-2 “Hold one note” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Singing louder
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-2 “Hold one note” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Tightening your throat
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-2 “Hold one note” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Slow, even air
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-2 “Hold one note” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Steady air makes a steady note. Extra volume and tension make it harder to control.
rows.translation: Jevn luft gir jevn tone. Ekstra lydstyrke og spenning gjør den vanskeligere å styre.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-2 “Hold one note” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Now E. Same low breath, same easy "ah."
rows.translation: Nå E. Samme dype pust, samme lette “ah”.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-2 “Hold one note” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Open vowel, open throat
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-2 “Hold one note” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Sing "ah" with your jaw dropped and the tip of your tongue resting behind your lower teeth. The sound flows out instead of getting squeezed.
rows.translation: Syng “ah” med senket kjeve og tungespissen hvilende bak undertennene. Lyden strømmer ut i stedet for å presses.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-2 “Hold one note” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: G this time. Drop your jaw and keep the "ah" open.
rows.translation: G denne gangen. Senk kjeven og hold “ah” åpen.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-2 “Hold one note” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Hold and breathe
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-2 “Hold one note” · step 7 (along) · title

rows.source: Match a pitch
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-3 “Match a pitch” · title

rows.source: Hear it, then sing it
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-3 “Match a pitch” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Matching pitch means singing the same note you hear. Listen, imagine the note for a moment, then sing softly and adjust until it settles.
rows.translation: Å treffe tonehøyden betyr å synge samme tone som du hører. Lytt, forestill deg tonen et øyeblikk, og syng så svakt og juster til den treffer.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-3 “Match a pitch” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Sing E softly, then adjust until it settles.
rows.translation: Syng E svakt, og juster til den treffer.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-3 “Match a pitch” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Flat and sharp
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-3 “Match a pitch” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Flat means under the target pitch; sharp means over it. If you're flat, lift a little. If you're sharp, ease down. Small moves work best.
rows.translation: For lavt betyr under måltonen; for høyt betyr over. Er du for lav, løft litt. Er du for høy, senk forsiktig. Små bevegelser virker best.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-3 “Match a pitch” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Timbre says you're flat. What do you do?
rows.translation: Timbre sier at du er for lav. Hva gjør du?
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-3 “Match a pitch” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Sing a little higher
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-3 “Match a pitch” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Sing a little lower
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-3 “Match a pitch” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Sing louder
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-3 “Match a pitch” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Flat means under the note, so lift the pitch slightly.
rows.translation: For lavt betyr under tonen, så løft tonehøyden litt.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-3 “Match a pitch” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Two notes this time: D, then G. Take a breath between them.
rows.translation: To toner denne gangen: D, så G. Pust mellom dem.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-3 “Match a pitch” · step 7 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Warm up gently
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-4 “Warm up gently” · title

rows.source: Hum to warm up
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-4 “Warm up gently” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Humming with your lips closed is a gentle warm-up. You should feel a light buzz on your lips and nose. Keep it soft and easy.
rows.translation: Nynning med lukkede lepper er skånsom oppvarming. Du skal kjenne lett vibrasjon på leppene og i nesen. Hold det svakt og lett.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-4 “Warm up gently” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Hum C, E and G, one at a time. Keep it light.
rows.translation: Nynn C, E og G, én om gangen. Hold det lett.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-4 “Warm up gently” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Lip trills
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-4 “Warm up gently” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: Close your lips loosely and blow so they flutter like a motorboat, then add your voice. It keeps your throat relaxed while your voice wakes up.
rows.translation: Lukk leppene løst og blås så de flagrer som en motorbåt, og legg så til stemmen. Det holder halsen avslappet mens stemmen våkner.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-4 “Warm up gently” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Lip trill on G, E, then C. If your lips stop, press your cheeks lightly.
rows.translation: Leppetrill på G, E, så C. Hvis leppene stopper, trykk lett på kinnene.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-4 “Warm up gently” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: A note feels tight or scratchy. What do you do?
rows.translation: En tone føles stram eller skrapende. Hva gjør du?
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-4 “Warm up gently” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Push harder through it
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-4 “Warm up gently” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Clear your throat hard
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-4 “Warm up gently” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Stop, rest, and try it softer
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-4 “Warm up gently” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Strain is a signal to ease off. Rest, sip some water, and come back lighter.
rows.translation: Anstrengelse er et signal om å lette trykket. Hvil, ta litt vann og kom tilbake lettere.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-4 “Warm up gently” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Easy hum
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-4 “Warm up gently” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.source: Stand tall, breathe low, and start each note softly. Rest between steps if your voice feels tired.
rows.translation: Stå oppreist, pust dypt og start hver tone svakt. Hvil mellom trinnene hvis stemmen føles sliten.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · challenge voc-1-5 “First notes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: E, then G. Hear each one before you sing it.
rows.translation: E, så G. Hør hver tone før du synger den.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · challenge voc-1-5 “First notes” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: What does sharp mean?
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · challenge voc-1-5 “First notes” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Under the target pitch
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · challenge voc-1-5 “First notes” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Louder than the note
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · challenge voc-1-5 “First notes” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Over the target pitch
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · challenge voc-1-5 “First notes” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Sharp is over the target pitch; flat is under it.
rows.translation: For høyt er over måltonens høyde; for lavt er under.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · challenge voc-1-5 “First notes” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Sing D softly, then adjust until it settles.
rows.translation: Syng D svakt, og juster til den treffer.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · challenge voc-1-5 “First notes” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Up and home
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · challenge voc-1-5 “First notes” · step 7 (along) · title

rows.source: Mary Had a Little Lamb needs three notes: E, D and C, each a step from the next. Sing it where it feels easy; Timbre hears the right note in any octave.
rows.translation: Mary Had a Little Lamb trenger tre toner: E, D og C, hver ett trinn fra neste. Syng der det føles lett; Timbre hører riktig tone i alle oktaver.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · song voc-1-6 “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: E, D, C: three steps down to home.
rows.translation: E, D, C: tre trinn ned til grunntonen.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · song voc-1-6 “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Pitch matching
rows.context: Singing · Unit 2 “Pitch matching” · title

rows.source: Hear a note, sing it back, and move by small steps.
rows.translation: Hør en tone, syng den tilbake og beveg deg i små trinn.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 2 “Pitch matching” · unit summary

rows.source: Hear it first
rows.context: Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-1 “Hear it first” · title

rows.source: Imagine before you sing
rows.context: Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-1 “Hear it first” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Before you sing, hear the note in your head for a second. That pause lets your voice aim for the pitch instead of hunting for it.
rows.translation: Før du synger, hør tonen i hodet et sekund. Pausen lar stemmen sikte mot tonehøyden i stedet for å lete etter den.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-1 “Hear it first” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Hear D in your head, then sing it.
rows.translation: Hør D i hodet, og syng den så.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-1 “Hear it first” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Hear F in your head, then sing it.
rows.translation: Hør F i hodet, og syng den så.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-1 “Hear it first” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Your first try lands flat. What next?
rows.translation: Første forsøk lander for lavt. Hva nå?
rows.context: Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-1 “Hear it first” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Lift a little and hold
rows.context: Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-1 “Hear it first” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Give up on that note
rows.context: Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-1 “Hear it first” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Jump up a lot
rows.context: Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-1 “Hear it first” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Small changes find the note fastest. Lift gently and let it settle.
rows.translation: Små endringer finner tonen raskest. Løft forsiktig og la den falle på plass.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-1 “Hear it first” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Hear A in your head, then sing it.
rows.translation: Hør A i hodet, og syng den så.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-1 “Hear it first” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Three notes in a row: D, F, A.
rows.translation: Tre toner på rad: D, F, A.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-1 “Hear it first” · step 7 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Unison and repeats
rows.context: Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-2 “Unison and repeats” · title

rows.source: Unison: the same note
rows.context: Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-2 “Unison and repeats” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Unison means two sounds on exactly the same pitch. When they match, they blend into one; when they're slightly off, you hear a wobble.
rows.translation: Unisont betyr to lyder med nøyaktig samme tonehøyde. Når de stemmer, smelter de sammen; når de er litt ulike, hører du svevninger.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-2 “Unison and repeats” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Sing E and hold it in tune.
rows.translation: Syng E og hold tonen ren.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-2 “Unison and repeats” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Repeat a note cleanly
rows.context: Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-2 “Unison and repeats” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: To sing the same note twice, stop the air for a moment, then start again on a soft "da." Don't slide between them.
rows.translation: For å synge samme tone to ganger stopper du luften et øyeblikk og starter igjen på et mykt “da”. Ikke gli mellom dem.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-2 “Unison and repeats” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Sing E three times on "da," with a tiny gap each time.
rows.translation: Syng E tre ganger på “da”, med et lite mellomrom hver gang.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-2 “Unison and repeats” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Same note, fresh start
rows.context: Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-2 “Unison and repeats” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.source: Steps and half steps
rows.context: Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-3 “Steps and half steps” · title

rows.source: A step is the next note
rows.context: Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-3 “Steps and half steps” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A step moves to the next note of a scale, up or down. Steps are the smallest, easiest moves to sing in tune.
rows.translation: Et trinn går til neste tone i en skala, opp eller ned. Trinn er de minste, enkleste bevegelsene å synge rent.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-3 “Steps and half steps” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Step up: C, D, E.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-3 “Steps and half steps” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Did it go up or down?
rows.context: Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-3 “Steps and half steps” · step 3 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.source: A half step is the smallest step, like E to F, with no note between. Most neighboring scale notes, like C and D, are a whole step apart: two half steps.
rows.translation: En halvtone er minste trinn, som E til F, uten tone imellom. De fleste nabotoner i skalaen, som C og D, har en heltone mellom seg: to halvtoner.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-3 “Steps and half steps” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: E, up a half step to F, and back.
rows.translation: E, en halvtone opp til F og tilbake.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-3 “Steps and half steps” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Step by step
rows.context: Singing · Unit 2 · lesson voc-2-3 “Steps and half steps” · step 7 (along) · title
